title: MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI
title_zh: MIRTO: 一个注册门控、多宇宙测试的无监督异常分割脑MRI评估协议

paragraphs.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model’s voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT’s latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.
paragraphs.zh: 用于脑磁共振成像的无监督异常检测（UAD）方法通常通过单一分数进行排名，但该分数的计算依赖于极少被报告的决策：每个异常图如何与参考图像对齐、阈值如何以及在哪些数据上设定，以及使用了何种假阳性容忍度、指标、聚合方式和病变定义。 我们提出了 MIRTO，一种评估协议，它将上述决策显性化并衡量其影响。 该协议通过配准检查和无需标签的已知能力诊断来约束每次比较的几何结构，仅在验证数据上设定阈值，并报告测试数据中实际实现的假阳性体积；它还对 15,552 条合理的评估流程重复每次比较，并附带具有多重性控制的成对受试者自助置信区间。 将 MIRTO 应用于在相同健康数据上训练并在 312 名 BraTS 2020 受试者上进行测试的四种 UAD 方法后发现，存储的异常图与参考图像之间的轴序不匹配，使扩散模型的体素 AUROC 从 0.873 降至 0.583，而其在切片级别的 AUROC 几乎未受影响。 在每种指标中，该方法至少能解释体素 AUROC 和 AUPRC 方差的 0.95，以及 Dice 系数的 0.77，但在病变敏感度方面仅能解释 0.14，此时病变定义和命中标准起主导作用。 在验证阈值下显著的 Dice 优势，在假阳性负担相等时消失，而精确的一致性分析将其归因于阈值的转移。 对 REFLECT 的潜在聚合方式进行无需训练的修改，在相同假阳性负担下将 Dice 系数提升了 0.052。 我们基于明确的标准测试了九种假设；由于同一队列被用于开发该协议，所有推断均为探索性分析。

paragraphs.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) in brain MRI learns what healthy anatomy looks like and flags whatever departs from it, so that pathology can be localised without lesion annotations [ 9 , 40 ] . The field has moved quickly, from variational and context-encoding autoencoders, including our own StRegA [ 9 , 21 ] , to diffusion models conditioned on the input [ 11 , 54 , 14 , 15 ] , rectified flows that correct an image in one step [ 12 ] , and frozen foundation-model features [ 24 , 31 ] . New methods are usually introduced with a table in which they rank first.
paragraphs.zh: 脑 MRI 中的无监督异常检测（UAD）通过学习正常解剖结构的外观来标记任何偏离该结构的异常，从而无需病灶标注即可定位病理区域 [9, 40]。 该领域发展迅速：从变分自编码器和上下文编码自编码器（包括我们提出的 StRegA [9, 21]），到以输入为条件的扩散模型 [11, 54, 14, 15]、单步修正图像的修正流 [12]，以及冻结的基础模型特征 [24, 31]。 新方法通常通过一张表格引入，并在其中排名第一。

sents.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) in brain MRI learns what healthy anatomy looks like and flags whatever departs from it, so that pathology can be localised without lesion annotations [ 9 , 40 ] .
sents.zh: 脑 MRI 中的无监督异常检测（UAD）通过学习正常解剖结构的外观来标记任何偏离该结构的异常，从而无需病灶标注即可定位病理区域 [9, 40]。

sents.en: The field has moved quickly, from variational and context-encoding autoencoders, including our own StRegA [ 9 , 21 ] , to diffusion models conditioned on the input [ 11 , 54 , 14 , 15 ] , rectified flows that correct an image in one step [ 12 ] , and frozen foundation-model features [ 24 , 31 ] .
sents.zh: 该领域发展迅速：从变分自编码器和上下文编码自编码器（包括我们提出的 StRegA [9, 21]），到以输入为条件的扩散模型 [11, 54, 14, 15]、单步修正图像的修正流 [12]，以及冻结的基础模型特征 [24, 31]。

sents.en: New methods are usually introduced with a table in which they rank first.
sents.zh: 新方法通常通过一张表格引入，并在其中排名第一。

paragraphs.en: Such a table is the end of a long chain of decisions, most of which a reader never sees. Every anomaly map lives on the grid of its own preprocessing and must be brought into the space of a common reference; a threshold has to be chosen, on some data, to meet some false-positive budget; Dice can be averaged over subjects, taken as a median, or pooled over voxels; a lesion must be defined before it can be counted as found; and the models were trained on particular healthy data with particular budgets. Each decision is defensible on its own. Together they span a large space of analysis paths, and it is well documented outside imaging that a reasonable change of path can change the conclusion [ 60 , 58 , 59 ] . In biomedical image analysis, rankings of challenge entries are known to be fragile to the metric and the aggregation [ 45 , 56 ] , and choices made with sight of the test data bias the estimate of performance [ 62 , 20 ] . UAD adds failure modes of its own. Thresholds are often tuned on the test cohort; slice-level detection scores reward any map that tracks how much brain a slice contains; and simply thresholding FLAIR intensity has been reported to give better Dice than several learnt models [ 48 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这样的表格是漫长决策链的终点，而读者几乎从未看到其中的大多数决策。 每张异常图都建立在其自身预处理流程的网格之上，必须被转换到通用参考空间内；需要在某些数据上选择一个阈值，以满足特定的假阳性容忍度；Dice 系数可以在受试者间取平均值、中位数，或在体素上进行汇总；在统计病灶被检出之前，必须先明确定义该病灶；此外，这些模型是在具有特定预算的特定健康数据上训练的。 每一项决策本身都是可以被合理辩护的。 这些决策共同覆盖了广泛的分析路径空间，并且在医学影像领域之外已有充分文献证明：分析路径的合理变化可能会改变最终结论 [ 60 , 58 , 59 ] 。 在生物医学图像分析中，挑战任务的排名对评估指标和聚合方式非常敏感 [ 45 , 56 ] ，而基于测试数据做出的选择会偏差性能估计值 [ 62 , 20 ] 。 UAD 本身也引入了新的失效模式。 阈值通常在测试队列上进行调整；切片级别的检测分数会奖励任何能够反映某一片切中脑组织含量的异常图；此外，有研究指出，对 FLAIR 信号强度进行简单阈值处理所获得的 Dice 系数，甚至优于多种学习模型 [ 48 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We asked two questions, and framed each component of the answer as a hypothesis to be tested. How much of a UAD leaderboard is decided by the evaluation rather than by the model? And can a protocol make that dependence visible, catch the errors it hides, and still say something definite about the models? Our answer is MIRTO ( M ultiverse-tested, I nterval-based, R egistration-gated, T hreshold-transfer-aware evaluati O n; Fig. 1 ). Where possible, each of its four components was checked on cases in which the right answer is known (synthetic volumes, injected corruptions, random calibration splits), and each changed at least one conclusion when applied to four current UAD families trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了两个问题，并将答案的每个组成部分构造成一个待检验的假设。 UAD 排行榜的结果在多大程度上取决于评估方法，而非模型本身？ 一种协议能否揭示这种依赖关系，捕捉其隐藏的错误，同时仍能对模型做出明确的判断？ 我们的答案是 MIRTO（多宇宙测试、区间化、注册门控、阈值转移感知评估；图 1）。 在可能的情况下，我们对其四个组成部分中的每一个都通过已知正确答案的案例进行了检验（合成数据体、人为注入的异常数据、随机校准划分）；当应用于使用相同健康数据训练并在 312 名 BraTS 2020 受试者上进行测试的四种当前 UAD 模型时，每个组成部分至少改变了一项结论。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction-based methods train a generative model on healthy scans and read anomalies from the residual between an input and its pseudo-healthy reconstruction. Autoencoders and their variants were surveyed by Baur et al. [ 9 ] . In our earlier work, StRegA, we combined a compact context-encoding VAE with pre- and post-processing steps chosen for clinical data, and reported a Dice of 0.642 on BraTS T2 tumours against 0.522 for the best baseline [ 21 ] . Denoising diffusion probabilistic models [ 33 ] improved reconstruction fidelity but tend either to copy the anomaly or to hallucinate healthy tissue that differs from the subject. Patched diffusion [ 10 ] , automatic masking and re-sampling (AutoDDPM) [ 14 ] , implicit guidance (THOR) [ 15 ] , masked diffusion (MAD-AD) [ 13 ] , cold-diffusion restorations (DISYRE) [ 51 ] and aggregated normative diffusion (ANDi) [ 29 ] each address this dilemma differently. Kascenas et al. showed that the spatial scale and magnitude of the training noise largely determine how well denoising autoencoders and diffusion models detect anomalies, and that a denoising autoencoder trained with coarse noise is competitive with far more complex models [ 37 ] . Two lines condition the denoiser on the input itself: cDDPM conditions on a learnt encoding of the image so that the reconstruction keeps the subject’s intensity characteristics [ 11 ] , and UCAD-CDM (here UCCD) conditions on a contrastive encoder trained to be invariant to the anomaly factor [ 54 ] . REFLECT replaces iterative sampling by a rectified flow [ 44 ] in the latent space of a VAE, transporting an abnormal latent to the healthy manifold in essentially one Euler step [ 12 ] . Feature-based methods compare deep features with those of healthy references: AnomalyDINO uses frozen DINOv2 [ 53 ] patch features and nearest-neighbour distances to a memory bank [ 24 ] ; Dinomaly and Dinomaly2 reconstruct foundation-model features [ 31 , 30 ] ; SCRD4AD uses scale-aware contrastive reverse distillation [ 41 ] . IterMask3D refines masks iteratively in 3D at test time [ 43 ] . We study REFLECT, UCCD, cDDPM and AnomalyDINO, which cover one-step transport, two forms of conditioned diffusion and a training-free foundation-model memory bank.
paragraphs.zh: 基于重建的方法通过在健康扫描数据上训练生成模型，并从输入与其伪健康重建之间的残差中读取异常。 Baur等人[9]对自编码器及其变体进行了综述。 在我们早期的工作StRegA中，我们将一个紧凑的上下文编码VAE与为临床数据选择的预处理和后处理步骤相结合，并在BraTS T2肿瘤数据集上报告了0.642的Dice系数，优于最佳基线方法的0.522[21]。 去噪扩散概率模型[33]提高了重建保真度，但往往要么复制异常区域，要么生成与受试者不同的健康组织。 Patched diffusion[10]、自动掩码和重采样（AutoDDPM）[14]、隐式引导（THOR）[15]、掩码扩散（MAD-AD）[13]、冷扩散恢复（DISYRE）[51]以及聚合规范扩散（ANDi）[29]各自以不同方式解决了这一困境。 Kascenas等人指出，训练噪声的空间尺度和幅度在很大程度上决定了去噪自编码器和扩散模型检测异常的能力，并且使用粗噪声训练的自编码器可以与复杂得多的模型相媲美[37]。 两种方法将去噪器与输入本身进行条件约束：cDDPM基于图像的已学习编码进行条件约束，以确保重建保留受试者的强度特征[11]；而UCAD-CDM（此处为UCCD）则基于一个经过对比度编码器训练、对异常因子保持不变性的模型进行条件约束[54]。 REFLECT用修正流[44]替代了VAE潜在空间中的迭代采样，从而在基本只需一个欧拉步的情况下将异常潜在变量传输到健康流形上[12]。 基于特征的方法将深度特征与健康参考特征进行比较：AnomalyDINO使用冻结的DINOv2[53]块特征以及与记忆库[24]中最近邻的距离；Dinomaly和Dinomaly2重建基础模型的特征[31, 30]；SCRD4AD则使用感知尺度的对比反向蒸馏[41]。 IterMask3D在测试时以迭代方式在三维空间中对掩码进行优化[43]。 我们研究了REFLECT、UCCD、cDDPM和AnomalyDINO，这些方法涵盖了一步传输、两种形式的条件扩散以及无需训练的基础模型记忆库。

sents.zh: 去噪扩散概率模型[33]提高了重建保真度，但往往要么复制异常区域，要么生成与受试者不同的健康组织。

sents.en: Patched diffusion [ 10 ] , automatic masking and re-sampling (AutoDDPM) [ 14 ] , implicit guidance (THOR) [ 15 ] , masked diffusion (MAD-AD) [ 13 ] , cold-diffusion restorations (DISYRE) [ 51 ] and aggregated normative diffusion (ANDi) [ 29 ] each address this dilemma differently.
sents.zh: Patched diffusion[10]、自动掩码和重采样（AutoDDPM）[14]、隐式引导（THOR）[15]、掩码扩散（MAD-AD）[13]、冷扩散恢复（DISYRE）[51]以及聚合规范扩散（ANDi）[29]各自以不同方式解决了这一困境。

sents.en: Kascenas et al. showed that the spatial scale and magnitude of the training noise largely determine how well denoising autoencoders and diffusion models detect anomalies, and that a denoising autoencoder trained with coarse noise is competitive with far more complex models [ 37 ] .
sents.zh: Kascenas等人指出，训练噪声的空间尺度和幅度在很大程度上决定了去噪自编码器和扩散模型检测异常的能力，并且使用粗噪声训练的自编码器可以与复杂得多的模型相媲美[37]。

sents.en: Two lines condition the denoiser on the input itself: cDDPM conditions on a learnt encoding of the image so that the reconstruction keeps the subject’s intensity characteristics [ 11 ] , and UCAD-CDM (here UCCD) conditions on a contrastive encoder trained to be invariant to the anomaly factor [ 54 ] .
sents.zh: 两种方法将去噪器与输入本身进行条件约束：cDDPM基于图像的已学习编码进行条件约束，以确保重建保留受试者的强度特征[11]；而UCAD-CDM（此处为UCCD）则基于一个经过对比度编码器训练、对异常因子保持不变性的模型进行条件约束[54]。

sents.en: REFLECT replaces iterative sampling by a rectified flow [ 44 ] in the latent space of a VAE, transporting an abnormal latent to the healthy manifold in essentially one Euler step [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: REFLECT用修正流[44]替代了VAE潜在空间中的迭代采样，从而在基本只需一个欧拉步的情况下将异常潜在变量传输到健康流形上[12]。

sents.en: Feature-based methods compare deep features with those of healthy references: AnomalyDINO uses frozen DINOv2 [ 53 ] patch features and nearest-neighbour distances to a memory bank [ 24 ] ; Dinomaly and Dinomaly2 reconstruct foundation-model features [ 31 , 30 ] ; SCRD4AD uses scale-aware contrastive reverse distillation [ 41 ] .
sents.zh: 基于特征的方法将深度特征与健康参考特征进行比较：AnomalyDINO使用冻结的DINOv2[53]块特征以及与记忆库[24]中最近邻的距离；Dinomaly和Dinomaly2重建基础模型的特征[31, 30]；SCRD4AD则使用感知尺度的对比反向蒸馏[41]。

sents.en: IterMask3D refines masks iteratively in 3D at test time [ 43 ] .
sents.zh: IterMask3D在测试时以迭代方式在三维空间中对掩码进行优化[43]。

sents.en: We study REFLECT, UCCD, cDDPM and AnomalyDINO, which cover one-step transport, two forms of conditioned diffusion and a training-free foundation-model memory bank.
sents.zh: 我们研究了REFLECT、UCCD、cDDPM和AnomalyDINO，这些方法涵盖了一步传输、两种形式的条件扩散以及无需训练的基础模型记忆库。

paragraphs.en: Comparative studies have repeatedly found evaluation to be the weak link. Meissen et al. showed that thresholding FLAIR scans gives better Dice and precision-recall curves than several learnt anomaly detectors on tumour and multiple-sclerosis data [ 48 ] . Lagogiannis et al. re-ran a diverse set of methods in a common framework on several datasets and found that feature-modelling methods, many from industrial inspection, set the state of the art [ 40 ] . Two broad benchmarks unify methods across medical domains: BMAD assembles six datasets from five domains, amongst them brain MRI, and fifteen algorithms [ 6 ] , and MedIAnomaly compares thirty methods on seven datasets of five modalities, for both image-level classification and pixel-level segmentation [ 18 ] . Bercea et al. argued that the quality of the normative reconstruction, which the usual metrics ignore, governs downstream behaviour [ 16 ] . A recent multi-centre benchmark selected thresholds on separate validation scans, reported Dice from 0.03 to 0.65 across algorithms and found biases with scanner, lesion size, age and sex [ 28 ] . Myles et al. recast UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem and derived several existing scores as instances of one energy [ 50 ] . These works compare methods under a fixed protocol, or improve the scoring rule; none quantifies how much of the resulting ranking the protocol itself determines, nor checks the geometric correctness of the comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 比较研究反复发现，评估环节是薄弱环节。 Meissen等人指出，对FLAIR扫描进行阈值分割所获得的Dice系数和精确率-召回率曲线，优于多种基于学习的异常检测器在肿瘤和多发性硬化数据上的表现 [48]。 Lagogiannis等人在一个通用框架中，于多个数据集上重新运行了多样化方法，发现特征建模方法（其中许多来自工业检测领域）代表了当前最先进的水平 [40]。 有两个广泛的基准测试统一了不同医学领域的方法：BMAD整合了来自五个领域的六个数据集（包括脑MRI）和十五种算法 [6]；而MedIAnomaly则在五种模态的七个数据集上比较了三十种方法，涵盖图像级分类和像素级分割任务 [18]。 Bercea等人认为，常规指标所忽略的规范重建质量，决定了后续处理的表现 [16]。 一项近期的多中心基准测试在独立的验证扫描数据上选择了阈值，报告了不同算法间Dice系数从0.03到0.65的变化，并发现了扫描仪、病变大小、年龄和性别带来的偏差 [28]。 Myles等人将UAD重新表述为一个贝叶斯逆问题，并将若干现有评分指标推导为同一能量函数的具体实例 [50]。 这些研究要么在固定协议下比较方法，要么改进评分规则；但没有一项量化了协议本身对最终排名结果的影响程度，也未验证比较结果的几何正确性。

paragraphs.en: Maier-Hein et al. showed that challenge rankings change with the metric and the aggregation [ 45 ] , and the Metrics Reloaded consortium catalogued metric pitfalls and recommendations [ 46 , 56 ] , including the dependence of overlap metrics on structure size [ 61 ] . Multiverse analysis [ 60 ] and specification curves [ 59 ] evaluate a conclusion over all defensible analysis paths; the many-analysts design shows how widely reasonable paths diverge [ 58 ] . Selection on the evaluation data inflates estimates [ 62 , 20 ] . Across medical imaging, Varoquaux and Cheplygina traced how biases enter at every step from data to evaluation [ 63 ] ; Christodoulou et al. found that more than half of the MICCAI 2023 segmentation papers did not assess performance variability and that only one reported confidence intervals [ 23 ] ; and a Bayesian analysis of published comparisons estimated a probability of a false outperformance claim above 5% for 86% of classification and 53% of segmentation papers [ 22 ] . In machine learning generally, data sampling, initialisation and hyperparameter choice add enough variance to change benchmark conclusions [ 17 ] . MIRTO brings these ideas to UAD and adds what segmentation by thresholding needs: an explicit operating point.
paragraphs.zh: Maier-Hein 等人指出，挑战排名会随评估指标和聚合方式而变化 [45]；Metrics Reloaded 联盟则梳理了评估指标的潜在问题与改进建议 [46, 56]，包括重叠度指标对结构规模的依赖性问题 [61]。 多宇宙分析 [60] 和规格曲线 [59] 能够基于所有合理的分析路径来评估一项结论；而“多位分析师”设计则展示了合理分析路径之间的差异程度 [58]。 在评估数据上的选择会导致估计值被高估 [62, 20]。 在医学影像领域，Varoquaux 和 Cheplygina 追踪了偏见如何从数据到评估的每一步中引入 [63]；Christodoulou 等人发现，超过一半的 MICCAI 2023 分割论文未评估性能波动性，且仅有一篇报告了置信区间 [23]；此外，对已发表比较研究进行贝叶斯分析后估计，86% 的分类论文和 53% 的分割论文存在超过 5% 的虚假性能优势声明概率 [22]。 在机器学习领域，数据采样、初始化和超参数选择本身就会引入足够的变异性，从而改变基准测试的结论 [17]。 MIRTO 将这些理念应用于 UAD，并为基于阈值的分割方法补充了关键要素：一个明确的运行点。

paragraphs.en: Conformal risk control (CRC) chooses a threshold on calibration data so that the expected value of a bounded, monotone loss on a new exchangeable case is at most α \alpha [ 2 ] ; risk-controlling prediction sets (RCPS) [ 8 ] and Learn-then-Test [ 1 ] give control with high probability over the calibration set instead; see [ 3 ] for an introduction. We use the loss “this scan exceeds its false-positive budget”. For such an indicator loss CRC reduces to split-conformal calibration, whose coverage conditional on the calibration set follows a known Beta law [ 64 , 3 ] ; we use that law to state how often a small calibration set misses its target. Covariate-adjusted ROC analysis [ 36 ] provides the tool we use to separate anatomy from detection in slice-level scores.
paragraphs.zh: 共形风险控制（CRC）在校准数据上选择一个阈值，使得新交换案例中一个有界、单调的损失函数的期望值最多为 α \alpha [ 2 ]；风险控制预测集（RCPS）[ 8] 和“先学习后测试”方法 [ 1] 则是在校准集上以高概率实现控制；相关介绍请参见 [ 3]。 我们使用的损失函数是“本次扫描超出了其假阳性预算”。 对于此类指示性损失函数，CRC 可简化为分裂共形校准，其在给定校准集条件下的覆盖率遵循已知的 Beta 分布 [ 64 , 3]；我们利用该分布来说明较小的校准集会多频繁地未能达到其目标。 协变量调整的 ROC 分析 [ 36] 为我们提供了在切片级评分中区分解剖结构与检测结果的工具。

paragraphs.en: Our contribution is an evaluation protocol, the exact accounting that makes what it reports interpretable, and one method-level improvement evaluated with it; the experiments validate the protocol and apply it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括一项评估协议、使报告结果具有可解释性的精确计算方法，以及通过该协议评估的一项方法层面的改进；相关实验验证了该协议并加以应用。

paragraphs.en: Registration gate and label-free diagnostics. A gate that accepts correct registrations and rejects flips, transposes and two-slice offsets, and five discordance diagnostics computable without extra labels, two of which detect injected in-plane errors with power 1.000 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 0.05 in 30 subjects (Section 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 注册门与无标签诊断。 一种能够接受正确注册、拒绝翻转、转置和两切片偏移的门，以及五种无需额外标签即可计算的失配诊断方法，其中两种方法能在 30 名受试者中以 0.05 的误报率检测到注入的平面内错误，其检测能力分别为 1.000 和 1.000（第 2.3 节）。

sents.en: Registration gate and label-free diagnostics.
sents.zh: 注册门与无标签诊断。

sents.en: A gate that accepts correct registrations and rejects flips, transposes and two-slice offsets, and five discordance diagnostics computable without extra labels, two of which detect injected in-plane errors with power 1.000 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 0.05 in 30 subjects (Section 2.3 ).
sents.zh: 一种能够接受正确注册、拒绝翻转、转置和两切片偏移的门，以及五种无需额外标签即可计算的失配诊断方法，其中两种方法能在 30 名受试者中以 0.05 的误报率检测到注入的平面内错误，其检测能力分别为 1.000 和 1.000（第 2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Operating points that account for threshold transfer. Validation-only thresholds, realised rather than nominal burden, a threshold-transfer gap with an exact decomposition of any contrast into a map term and a transfer term (Identity 1 ), and a conformal per-scan burden guarantee, for which we apply the known training-conditional law of split-conformal calibration to state, from the calibration size alone, how often a calibration set misses its target (Lemma 1 ; Section 2.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 考虑阈值转移的运作点。 仅用于验证的阈值、实际负担而非名义负担、一个具有任何对比度精确分解为映射项和转移项（恒等式 1）的阈值转移差距，以及每次扫描的共形负担保证；对于后者，我们应用已知的训练条件分裂共形校准定律，仅根据校准集的大小即可说明校准集偏离目标的情况出现的频率（引理 1；第 2.4 节）。

sents.en: Operating points that account for threshold transfer.
sents.zh: 考虑阈值转移的运作点。

paragraphs.en: Exact accounting of post-processing and metrics. Elementary identities, applied to UAD, that split a post-processing gain at equal burden into an effect at fixed threshold and a threshold relaxation, state exactly when deleting a component raises Dice (Identities 4 and 5 ), and decompose pooled Dice and pooled AUROC so as to explain when subject-level and pooled rankings disagree (Identities 2 and 3 ). Their value lies in what they let a reader attribute, not in their difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 对后处理过程和指标进行精确计算。 这些基本恒等式应用于 UAD，将均摊负担的后处理增益分解为固定阈值下的效应和阈值放宽，并明确说明删除某个组件何时会提升 Dice 值（恒等式 4 和 5），同时分解合并后的 Dice 值和合并后的 AUROC 值，从而解释个体层面排名与合并排名不一致的原因（恒等式 2 和 3）。 它们的价值在于能让读者归因于什么，而非其本身的难度。

sents.en: Exact accounting of post-processing and metrics.
sents.zh: 对后处理过程和指标进行精确计算。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation multiverse. Ten axes of evaluation choices, flip shares read together with the size of each difference, per-metric variance shares with bootstrap intervals, and the training data as an eleventh axis (Section 2.7 ).

paragraphs.en: We apply the protocol to four UAD methods and two model-free baselines. We do not claim that any method is best, nor that the inference is confirmatory: the 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and to test its hypotheses, so every test is exploratory (Section 2.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将该协议应用于四种 UAD 方法和两种无模型基线方法。 我们不声称任何方法是最佳的，也不认为该推论具有确认性：312 名受试者既用于开发该协议，也用于检验其假设，因此所有测试均为探索性的（第 2.8 节）。

Lemma 1 is not new. With an indicator loss, CRC selects an order statistic of the calibration scores exactly as split-conformal prediction does, and 1 − ρ 1-\rho is then the coverage conditional on the calibration set, whose Beta law is the classical training-conditional result of the conformal literature [ 64 , 3 ] . We state it because, applied to the per-scan burden, it turns a marginal guarantee into a prediction that a user can make before seeing any test data. For n = 24 n=24 and α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 , j = 1 j=1 and ρ ∼ Beta ⁡ ( 2 , 23 ) \rho\sim\mathrm{Beta}(2,23) , whose mean is 0.080 0.080 , whose 97.5th percentile is 0.211 0.211 , and which puts only 70.8 % 70.8\% of its mass at or below α \alpha . CRC therefore controls the average over calibration sets whilst leaving roughly three calibration sets in ten above the target; a guarantee that holds with high probability for the calibration set in hand requires RCPS or Learn-then-Test [ 8 , 1 ] , at the price of a stricter threshold. We compare this prediction with 1,000 random calibration splits in Section 3.3 . Figure 3 c illustrates the construction.

paragraphs.en: Every experiment in Section 3 tests a hypothesis. Nine primary hypotheses, H1 to H9, each carry an explicit decision criterion (Table 9 ); eight secondary hypotheses predict specific effects that follow from the identities and from the primary analyses (Appendix 0.F ); and where an experiment has no decision criterion, its hypothesis is marked exploratory and judged from intervals alone. A hypothesis is called supported only if its criterion is met, and a failed criterion is reported as such. The same 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and to test these hypotheses, so the tests are exploratory, not confirmatory: an explicit criterion prevents a hypothesis from being bent to fit its outcome, but it cannot remove the influence of other analyses of the same cohort. Confirmation requires an independent cohort, evaluated under a pre-registered protocol in which the training set and every threshold rule are fixed. All analyses run on stored maps without a GPU; the cost of training and inference is reported in Appendix 0.D.10 .
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节中的每一项实验都检验一个假设。 九个主要假设（H1 至 H9）各自包含一个明确的决策标准（表 9）；八个次要假设则预测了由身份信息和主要分析推导出的特定效应（附录 0.F）；而对于没有决策标准的实验，其假设会被标记为探索性，并仅根据区间进行判断。 只有当某个假设满足其决策标准时，它才被称为得到支持；若未满足，则会明确报告该标准未通过。 相同的 312 名受试者既用于制定方案，也用于检验这些假设，因此这些测试属于探索性而非验证性测试：明确的决策标准可以防止为迎合结果而曲解假设，但无法消除对同一群体其他分析的影响。 验证需要一个独立的受试群体，并在预先注册的方案下进行评估，其中训练集和所有阈值规则均固定不变。 所有分析均在存储的地图上运行，且不使用 GPU；训练与推理的成本报告见附录 0.D.10。

paragraphs.en: BraTS 2020 [ 49 , 4 , 5 ] provides multi-institutional pre-operative glioma MRI, co-registered to a common template, resampled to 1 ​ mm 3 1\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} and skull-stripped by the organisers. We evaluate on T2; FLAIR is used only by the FLAIR baseline. The reference is the whole tumour (labels 1, 2 and 4). We use 312 test subjects and 24 disjoint validation subjects, split at random. The canonical arrays are our copy of the data, cropped through-plane to remove empty slices: 240 × 240 240\times 240 in-plane at 1 mm and 98 to 149 slices (median 139); cropping removes no tumour voxel. Median whole-tumour volume is 91.7 ​ cm 3 91.7\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (IQR 53.2 53.2 – 147.8 147.8 ; range 7.3 7.3 – 361.8 361.8 ). The test reference contains 5,473 5{,}473 6-connected components, of which 472 reach the 50 ​ mm 3 50\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} floor (165 small, 307 large).
paragraphs.zh: BraTS 2020 [ 49 , 4 , 5 ] 提供了多机构术前胶质瘤 MRI 数据，这些数据已配准到通用模板，重采样至 1 mm³，并由组织方进行了颅骨剥离。 我们在 T2 上进行评估；FLAIR 仅被 FLAIR 基线模型使用。 参考数据为整个肿瘤（标签 1、2 和 4）。 我们使用了 312 个测试样本和 24 个互不重叠的验证样本，并通过随机方式划分。 标准数组是我们复制的数据集，通过沿平面裁剪以移除空切片：在平面内为 240 × 240，分辨率为 1 mm，包含 98 至 149 个切片（中位数为 139）；裁剪过程未移除任何肿瘤体素。 整个肿瘤体积的中位数为 91.7 cm³（IQR 53.2 – 147.8；范围 7.3 – 361.8）。 测试参考数据包含 5,473 个 6-连通组件，其中 472 个达到了 50 mm³ 的最低阈值（165 个小型，307 个大型）。

paragraphs.en: IXI [ 35 ] provides T1 and T2 scans from three London sites; our preprocessed T2 pool contains the Hammersmith Hospital (HH, 3 T) and Guy’s Hospital (Guys, 1.5 T) sites. MOOD [ 65 ] provides T1 brain scans. From these we formed five training sets (Table 2 ), named after their sources, and tested every model on BraTS T2. All main-text results use IXI-HH+Guys for every method. The choice rests on two grounds stated without reference to any score: IXI-HH+Guys matches the test contrast, and IXI-HH and IXI-Guys are strict subsets of it. Because all twenty method–training-set combinations were scored on the same test cohort, the choice is protected by its stated rationale, by showing that each evaluation finding holds with every set of training data (Appendix 0.E ), and by a confirmatory evaluation on a new cohort, to be pre-registered with this training set fixed. Within IXI-HH+Guys each method kept its own training protocol (REFLECT 504 volumes; UCCD 324 training and 81 validation volumes; cDDPM 361 and 92; AnomalyDINO a memory bank from 50 reference volumes), so a common training set means the same source data, not the same optimisation budget (Appendix 0.E ).
paragraphs.zh: IXI [ 35 ] 提供了来自伦敦三个地点的 T1 和 T2 扫描数据；我们预处理后的 T2 数据集包含了 Hammersmith 医院（HH，3 T）和 Guy’s 医院（Guys，1.5 T）的数据。 MOOD [ 65 ] 提供了大脑的 T1 扫描数据。 基于这些数据，我们构建了五个训练集（表 2），并以它们的来源命名，同时在 BraTS T2 上测试了所有模型。 正文中的所有结果均对每种方法使用了 IXI-HH+Guys 数据集。 这一选择基于两个理由，且未参考任何评分：IXI-HH+Guys 与测试数据的对比特征一致，而 IXI-HH 和 IXI-Guys 都是其严格子集。 由于所有二十种方法–训练集组合都在同一测试队列中进行了评分，因此这一选择的合理性得到了保障：既通过论证表明每个评估结果在所有训练数据集上均成立（附录 0.E），也通过在一个新队列上的确认性评估加以验证，且该评估预先注册并固定了此训练集。 在 IXI-HH+Guys 内部，每种方法都保留了自身的训练协议（REFLECT 使用 504 个体积；UCCD 使用 324 个训练体积和 81 个验证体积；cDDPM 使用 361 和 92 个体积；AnomalyDINO 使用来自 50 个参考体积的记忆库），因此共同的训练集意味着来源数据相同，而非优化预算相同（附录 0.E）。

paragraphs.en: Unless stated otherwise, all methods were trained on IXI-HH+Guys and evaluated on the 312 test subjects, intervals in brackets are 95% paired subject-bootstrap intervals, “Dice” is the subject mean at the validation threshold with plain thresholding, and b b is a nominal budget. Each subsection states the hypothesis that the experiment tests, reports the result and closes with a verdict. Hypotheses H1 to H9 carry explicit decision criteria (Table 9 ); secondary hypotheses predict specific effects (Appendix Table 63 ); hypotheses without a decision criterion are marked exploratory and judged from intervals alone. The main text reports the findings that bear on a conclusion; the full set of analyses, at every budget, aggregation and set of training data, is in Appendix 0.D , with one subsection for each subsection below.

paragraphs.en: A mapping error that permutes voxels within slices should push per-subject voxel AUROC below 0.5 and scramble its ranks across subjects, whilst leaving slice-level scores almost unchanged, because a slice that contains tumour still does so after any in-plane permutation. If so, label-free diagnostics can detect such errors without extra labels. H7 (diagnostic power): rank stability and the anti-location rate each detect in-plane flips and transposes with power of at least 0.95 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 in 60 subjects. A secondary hypothesis predicts that UCCD’s voxel AUROC falls under antero-posterior and left-right flips whereas AnomalyDINO’s slice-level AUROC does not fall under an antero-posterior flip.
paragraphs.zh: 一种在切片内置换体素的重映错误，应使每个受试者的体素AUROC降至0.5以下，并打乱其跨受试者的排名，同时几乎不改变切片级别的得分，因为包含肿瘤的切片在任何平面内置换后仍然包含肿瘤。 如果是这样，无标签诊断方法无需额外标签即可检测出此类错误。 H7（诊断能力）：排名稳定性与反位置率各自能够以至少0.95的功率检测到平面内的翻转和换位，同时假警报率为0.05，测试对象为60名受试者。 一个次要假设预测，UCCD的体素AUROC在前后翻转和左右翻转时会下降，而AnomalyDINO的切片级别AUROC在前后翻转时则不会下降。

paragraphs.en: Each method stores its maps in its own axis order, crop and resolution, so any comparison of methods with different preprocessing must undo these steps, and an error in doing so is easy to make and hard to see. Such errors arose in practice in assembling this benchmark. A mapping that read the stored cDDPM maps in the wrong axis order and ignored their field-of-view crop gave a voxel AUROC of 0.583; with the correct mapping the same maps gave 0.873, a change of + 0.290 ​ [ 0.277 , 0.302 ] +0.290\,[0.277,\,0.302] , with + 0.535 ​ [ 0.517 , 0.553 ] +0.535\,[0.517,\,0.553] in AUPRC and + 0.520 ​ [ 0.504 , 0.537 ] +0.520\,[0.504,\,0.537] in Dice at the validation threshold at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (Appendix 0.D.1 , Table 14 ). Slice-max AUROC moved by only + 0.112 ​ [ 0.099 , 0.125 ] +0.112\,[0.099,\,0.125] (median + 0.083 +0.083 ). This is the pattern the hypothesis predicts: a slice-level score is close to blind to the error that matters most for segmentation. The error is of the kind the registration gate is designed to reject (it fails in-plane flips and transposes on synthetic volumes; Section 2.3 ), and the label-free diagnostics flag it directly: under the wrong mapping 24% of cDDPM test subjects were anti-located (per-subject voxel AUROC < 0.5 <0.5 ). Two further instances of the same risk occurred with REFLECT. A second export of its maps with the same kind of axis error left 26% of test subjects anti-located and lowered voxel AUROC from 0.936 to 0.616 whilst slice AUROC stayed at 0.915 (with the correct mapping, 2 of 312 subjects were anti-located); and resampling REFLECT maps by simple zooming instead of with the mapped transform gave the published map a Dice of 0.089 instead of 0.548, which invalidated a comparison of score rules made with that resampling. Each error produced a plausible table. That is the case for gating geometry rather than assuming it.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法都按照其自身的轴顺序、裁剪和分辨率存储其映射，因此任何对具有不同预处理步骤的方法进行比较时，都必须撤销这些步骤；而在此过程中很容易犯错，且难以察觉。 在构建该基准测试的过程中，实践中确实出现了此类错误。 一种错误的映射方式以不正确的轴顺序读取已存储的 cDDPM 映射，并忽略了其视场裁剪，得到的体素 AUROC 为 0.583；而使用正确映射时，同一组映射的 AUROC 达到 0.873，变化量为 +0.290 [0.277, 0.302]，AUPRC 的变化量为 +0.535 [0.517, 0.553]，在验证阈值 20 cm³（20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）处的 Dice 系数变化量为 +0.520 [0.504, 0.537]（附录 0.D.1，表 14）。 切片最大值 AUROC 仅增加了 +0.112 [0.099, 0.125]（中位数为 +0.083）。 这正是该假设所预测的模式：切片级别的分数对分割任务中最关键的错误几乎不敏感。 这种错误属于注册门控机制旨在拒绝的类型（它在合成体数据上会失败于平面内翻转和转置；第 2.3 节），且无需标签的诊断方法能直接识别出该问题：在错误映射下，24% 的 cDDPM 测试样本出现了反向定位（每个样本的体素 AUROC < 0.5）。 在 REFLECT 中又发生了两起同类风险事件。 第二次导出其映射时，由于出现了同类型的轴顺序错误，导致 26% 的测试样本出现反向定位，体素 AUROC 从 0.936 降至 0.616，而切片 AUROC 仍保持在 0.915（使用正确映射时，312 个样本中仅有 2 个出现反向定位）；此外，若通过简单缩放而非使用映射变换来重采样 REFLECT 映射，则已发表的映射的 Dice 系数会从 0.548 降至 0.089，这使得基于该重采样结果的评分规则比较失效。 每种错误都生成了一张看似合理的表格。 这种情况适用于对门控几何结构进行验证，而非简单假设其正确性。

paragraphs.en: The gate passed 1,342 of 1,344 method–subject pairs (312 test and 24 validation subjects for each of four methods; Fig. 4 a). Every method’s applied transform was the cohort-wide overlap maximiser amongst the 56 candidates (criterion ii-a). The one subject that failed, for UCCD and cDDPM, which share a reference, failed only the overlap floor (iii) with D = 0.845 \mathrm{D}=0.845 ; its centroid error was within 3 mm and no alternative did better, so it is a label-fidelity exception, not a misregistration. Excluding it changed the interval-excludes-zero status of 5 of 588 contrasts, each with a bound within 0.0013 of zero, and moved no estimate by more than 0.008. A fixed overlap threshold of 0.95 would have failed 61 (REFLECT), 63 (AnomalyDINO) and 242 (UCCD, cDDPM) correctly registered subjects (Appendix Table 15 ): their own references had been resampled inside the method’s preprocessing (median label fidelity 0.966) or their tumour extended beyond the 100-slice field of view of UCCD and cDDPM (45 of 336 subjects). Across all twenty method–training-set combinations the same subject was the only failure.
paragraphs.zh: 该门控通过了 1,344 个方法-受试者对中的 1,342 对（四种方法中每种方法各有 312 名测试受试者和 24 名验证受试者；图 4a）。 每种方法所应用的变换都是 56 个候选变换中在整个队列范围内能最大化重叠度的变换（标准 ii-a）。 对于共享参考的 UCCD 和 cDDPM，唯一失败的受试者仅未能满足重叠度下限（iii），其中 D = 0.845 \mathrm{D}=0.845；其质心误差在 3 mm 以内，且没有其他替代方法表现更好，因此这是一个标签保真度的例外，而非配准错误。 排除该受试者后，588 个对比中 5 个的“区间不包含零”状态发生了变化（每个对比的边界与零的差值均不超过 0.0013），且没有任何估计值的变动超过 0.008。 若采用 0.95 的固定重叠度阈值，则会有 61 个（REFLECT）、63 个（AnomalyDINO）和 242 个（UCCD、cDDPM）正确配准的受试者失败（附录表 15）：这些受试者的参考图像在方法预处理阶段被重新采样（标签保真度中位数为 0.966），或其肿瘤超出了 UCCD 和 cDDPM 的 100 层视野范围（336 名受试者中有 45 名）。 在所有二十种方法-训练集组合中，同一受试者都是唯一的失败案例。

paragraphs.en: We injected controlled corruptions into the two pipelines whose geometry had been verified independently (Fig. 4 b; Appendix Table 16 ). In-plane flips and the transpose cost UCCD 0.34 to 0.50 Dice and 0.20 to 0.26 voxel AUROC, yet changed its slice-max AUROC by at most + 0.012 +0.012 . A corrupted map can even improve a standard metric: an antero-posterior flip raised AnomalyDINO’s slice-max AUROC by + 0.181 +0.181 and the transpose by + 0.099 +0.099 . Rank stability and the anti-location rate detected every in-plane flip and transpose with power 1.000 at a false-alarm rate of 0.05 already at n = 30 n=30 , which supports H7 (Table 17 ); the secondary hypothesis on flips held as well. They behave differently elsewhere: the anti-location rate stays near zero under through-plane shifts and reference dilation, so it is specific to localisation errors, whereas rank stability reacts to almost any perturbation of the per-subject ranking (power 1.000 for a two-slice shift that moved AUROC by only + 0.003 +0.003 ) and is better read as a change detector. Permuting 5% of subject identifiers was not detectable at n ≤ 312 n\leq 312 , and the Jaccard bound was never violated. Further robustness checks (excluding the failing subject, restricting to tumours inside every field of view, a through-plane offset check, spatial randomisation and a geometry factorial) are reported in Appendix 0.D.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个几何结构已独立验证的管道中注入了受控的扰动（图 4b；附录表 16）。 平面内翻转和转置使 UCCD 的 Dice 系数下降了 0.34 至 0.50，Voxel AUROC 下降了 0.20 至 0.26，但对其切片最大值 AUROC 的影响最多仅为 +0.012。 一个被扰动的地图甚至可能提升标准指标：一次前后翻转使 AnomalyDINO 的切片最大值 AUROC 提升了 +0.181，转置则使其提升了 +0.099。 在 n = 30 时，排名稳定性与反位置率已在 0.05 的误报率下以 1.000 的统计显著性检测出每一次平面内翻转和转置（表 17）；关于翻转的次要假设同样成立。 在其他情况下，它们的表现则不同：在跨平面位移和参考膨胀操作中，反位置率接近于零，因此它专门针对定位错误；而排名稳定性则对几乎任何对个体内排名的扰动都有反应（即使仅使 AUROC 提升 +0.003 的双切片位移也能达到 1.000 的统计显著性），因此更适合作为变化检测指标。 在 n ≤ 312 时，置换 5% 的受试者标识符无法被检测到，且 Jaccard 界从未被违反。 更多稳健性检验（排除失败的受试者、限定于每个视野内的肿瘤、跨平面偏移检查、空间随机化和几何因子分析）报告在附录 0.D.1 中。

paragraphs.en: If evaluation choices matter, the order of two methods should depend on them. H1 (ranking instability): some pair of methods takes its minority order in at least 20% of defensible universes (lower 95% bound of ϕ max \phi_{\max} at least 0.20). H2 (evaluation dominance): the evaluation axes, with their interactions with method, explain more of the variance of scores than the method does, with non-overlapping intervals. Because H2 pools metrics that live on different scales, we add an exploratory hypothesis that sharpens it: a metric measures a property of the method only if, within that metric, the method dominates the variance and the order of methods does not flip.
paragraphs.zh: 如果评估选项具有影响，那么两种方法的排序应当取决于这些选项。 H1（排序不稳定性）：在某些方法对当中，至少 20% 的可辩护宇宙中，它们会采用次要的排序（ϕ max \phi_{\max} 的下限 95% 置信区间至少为 0.20）。 H2（评估主导性）：评估维度及其与方法之间的相互作用，所解释的分数方差比方法本身更多，且两者的置信区间不重叠。 由于 H2 将处于不同量级的指标合并在一起，我们补充一个用于探索的假设以使其更精确：只有当某种指标内部，该方法主导了方差且方法间的排序不发生翻转时，该指标才衡量了方法的某个属性。

paragraphs.en: The decomposition within a metric separates rankings that belong to the method from rankings that the evaluation decides (Table 3 , Fig. 6 ). The method explained 0.954 ​ [ 0.933 , 0.966 ] 0.954\,[0.933,\,0.966] of the variance in voxel AUROC and 0.960 ​ [ 0.941 , 0.972 ] 0.960\,[0.941,\,0.972] in voxel AUPRC. Voxel AUROC gave a single order in every universe (REFLECT > > cDDPM > > UCCD > > AnomalyDINO); in voxel AUPRC only the aggregation changed the order, REFLECT and cDDPM exchanging places between subject-level and pooled values (Section 3.4 ). The method explained 0.770 ​ [ 0.738 , 0.787 ] 0.770\,[0.738,\,0.787] of the variance in Dice, but much of this is AnomalyDINO’s deficit. Amongst the three residual models every pair swapped places in a substantial share of Dice universes (within-metric flip shares 0.36 to 0.49), Dice gave six different orders, and each of REFLECT, UCCD and cDDPM ranked first in between 26% and 39% of them (Appendix 0.C , Table 13 ). The budget and the threshold protocol were the largest evaluation axes for Dice (0.108 and 0.056 of its variance, main effect plus interaction with method; point estimates). Lesion sensitivity was governed by the evaluation: the method explained 0.139 ​ [ 0.127 , 0.152 ] 0.139\,[0.127,\,0.152] of its variance and the axes 0.657 ​ [ 0.648 , 0.666 ] 0.657\,[0.648,\,0.666] , of which the lesion definition carried 0.338 and the hit criterion 0.269 (point estimates). Part of the lesion-definition share is a change of denominator common to all methods (Section 3.7 ), which cannot reorder them; the within-metric flip shares of 0.26 to 0.34 between residual models show that the evaluation choices reorder them as well.

The flips of these pairs therefore reflect the evaluation rather than closeness: each method leads by several Dice points in a large share of defensible evaluations, significantly so at some operating points, and which one leads is decided by the evaluation. UCCD versus cDDPM is different. Their median absolute Dice difference was 0.029, and although ten of the twelve contrasts favoured UCCD significantly at validation thresholds, none did at equal realised burden (Section 3.3 ); this pair is better described as close, with an apparent advantage that comes from threshold transfer. paragraphs.en: A common view holds that tuning a threshold on the test cohort simply inflates Dice. H6 (test-tuning optimism): the test-matched threshold overstates Dice by at least 0.02 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (lower bound of the transfer gap at least 0.02). Identity 1 suggests a competing account, in which the gap is a burden mismatch multiplied by a local slope, so that its sign follows that of b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta} and differs between methods; a secondary hypothesis predicted a positive gap for UCCD at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . For the per-scan burden, H8 (conformal control): CRC keeps the test exceedance within α + 0.02 \alpha+0.02 in all 128 calibrated combinations, and Lemma 1 predicts how the exceedance is distributed over calibration sets.
paragraphs.zh: 一种普遍的观点认为，在测试队列上调整阈值只会人为地夸大Dice系数。 H6（测试调优乐观假设）：与测试数据匹配的阈值会使Dice系数的估计值至少高估0.02（在20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}处，转移差距的下限至少为0.02）。 恒等式1提出了一种替代解释：该差距是负担不匹配与局部斜率的乘积，因此其符号取决于b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta}的符号，并在不同方法间存在差异；一个次要假设预测UCCD在5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}处会产生正的差距。 对于每次扫描的负担，H8（一致性控制）：CRC在所有128种校准组合中都将测试超概保持在α + 0.02 \alpha+0.02以内，而引理1预测了该超概在校准集上的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: At a nominal 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} the mean realised burden on test was 16.3 (REFLECT), 18.9 (UCCD), 12.9 (cDDPM) and 17.5 cm 3 (AnomalyDINO). The median was 3.0 to 10.1 cm 3 , the 95th percentile 37 to 64 cm 3 , the maximum 210 to 604 cm 3 , and between 15.7% and 29.8% of subjects exceeded 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (Table 4 , Fig. 7 a). The mean describes no typical subject; it is pulled up by a minority with very large false-positive volumes.
paragraphs.zh: 在标称体积为 20 cm³（20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）时，测试中实现的平均负担分别为 16.3（REFLECT）、18.9（UCCD）、12.9（cDDPM）和 17.5 cm³（AnomalyDINO）。 中位数为 3.0 至 10.1 cm³，第 95 百分位数为 37 至 64 cm³，最大值为 210 至 604 cm³，且 15.7% 到 29.8% 的受试者超过了 20 cm³（20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）（表 4，图 7a）。 平均值无法反映典型受试者的情况；少数具有极大假阳性体积的受试者拉高了该平均值。

paragraphs.en: The gap was 0.02 0.02 to 0.07 0.07 Dice for REFLECT and cDDPM at 5 to 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} , because their validation thresholds were conservative on test (REFLECT realised 3.3 ​ cm 3 3.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} at a nominal 5; cDDPM 12.9 ​ cm 3 12.9\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} at 20). For UCCD it was close to zero or negative ( − 0.008 ​ [ − 0.008 , − 0.007 ] -0.008\,[-0.008,\,-0.007] at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ): its validation threshold almost equalled the test-matched one (0.385 against 0.381 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ) and was slightly liberal ( 5.3 ​ cm 3 5.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} realised at 5). This is exactly the pattern Eq. ( 14 ) predicts: the sign of g ¯ \bar{g} follows the sign of b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta} , scaled by the local slope of Ψ \Psi . Where Ψ \Psi is flat the gap vanishes even for a large mismatch (UCCD at 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} : β ^ = 31.8 \hat{\beta}=31.8 , g ¯ = − 0.001 \bar{g}=-0.001 ). The gap therefore measures how well a validation threshold transfers, which differs between methods; it is not a uniform test-set optimism. This is why the secondary hypothesis of a positive UCCD gap at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} failed, and why H6, which required a lower bound of at least 0.02 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} , narrowly failed (lower bounds 0.0191 for REFLECT and 0.0199 for cDDPM).
paragraphs.zh: 对于 REFLECT 和 cDDPM，在 5 至 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 范围内，Dice 系数差异为 0.02 到 0.07，这是因为它们在测试集上的验证阈值较为保守（REFLECT 在名义值为 5 时实现了 3.3 ​ cm 3 3.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}；cDDPM 在 20 时实现了 12.9 ​ cm 3 12.9\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）。而对于 UCCD，该差异接近于零或为负值（在 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时为 −0.008 ​ [−0.008, −0.007] -0.008\,[-0.008,\,-0.007]）：其验证阈值几乎与测试集匹配阈值相等（在 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时分别为 0.385 和 0.381），且略微宽松（在 5 时实现了 5.3 ​ cm 3 5.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）。这正是方程 (14) 所预测的模式：g ¯ \bar{g} 的符号与 b − β ^ b-\hat{\beta} 的符号一致，并由 Ψ \Psi 的局部斜率进行缩放。当 Ψ \Psi 较为平坦时，即使存在较大的不匹配，该差异也会消失（UCCD 在 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时：β ^ = 31.8 \hat{\beta}=31.8，g ¯ = −0.001 \bar{g}=-0.001）。因此，该差异衡量的是验证阈值在不同方法间的迁移能力，这种能力因方法而异，并非一种统一的测试集乐观偏差。这就是为什么 UCCD 在 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时具有正差异的次要假设未能成立，以及为什么 H6（要求在 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时至少达到 0.02 的下限）也仅以微弱差距未通过（REFLECT 和 cDDPM 的下限分别为 0.0191 和 0.0199）。

paragraphs.en: At the validation threshold UCCD beat cDDPM at every budget, + 0.020 ​ [ 0.011 , 0.029 ] +0.020\,[0.011,\,0.029] at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} with p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 (Fig. 8 ). At equal realised burden the difference was − 0.001 ​ [ − 0.012 , 0.009 ] -0.001\,[-0.012,\,0.009] ( p H = 1.00 p_{\mathrm{H}}=1.00 ), and every interval at every budget included zero. Identity 1 accounts for the change: Δ val − Δ ⋆ = − ( g ¯ UCCD − g ¯ cDDPM ) = − ( 0.002 − 0.023 ) = + 0.021 \Delta^{\mathrm{val}}-\Delta^{\star}=-(\bar{g}_{\mathrm{UCCD}}-\bar{g}_{\mathrm{cDDPM}})=-(0.002-0.023)=+0.021 , against an observed + 0.021 +0.021 . Across all 24 model pairs and budgets, the two sides of Eq. ( 13 ), computed from separately produced tables, agreed within 0.0045 Dice with the grid-matched threshold and within 0.0017 with the interpolated one; the residual is the difference between the threshold grids of the two tables. The UCCD advantage at validation thresholds is a property of how its threshold transfers, not of its map.
paragraphs.zh: 在验证阈值下，UCCD 在所有预算水平上都优于 cDDPM：在 20 cm³（20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）且 p H < 0.005（p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005）时，优势为 +0.020 [0.011, 0.029]（+0.020\,[0.011,\,0.029]）（图 8）。在实现负担相等时，差异为 −0.001 [−0.012, 0.009]（-0.001\,[-0.012,\,0.009]）（p H = 1.00（p_{\mathrm{H}}=1.00）），且所有预算水平下的每个置信区间都包含零。恒等式 1 解释了这一变化：Δ val − Δ ⋆ = − ( g ¯ UCCD − g ¯ cDDPM ) = − ( 0.002 − 0.023 ) = + 0.021 \Delta^{\mathrm{val}}-\Delta^{\star}=-(\bar{g}_{\mathrm{UCCD}}-\bar{g}_{\mathrm{cDDPM}})=-(0.002-0.023)=+0.021，与观测到的 +0.021（+0.021）一致。在所有 24 个模型对和预算水平中，方程 (13) 的两边分别由独立生成的表格计算得出，其与网格匹配阈值之间的差异在 0.0045 Dice 范围内，与内插阈值之间的差异则在 0.0017 范围内；残差是这两个表格的阈值网格之间的差异。UCCD 在验证阈值上的优势源于其阈值转换方式，而非其映射本身。

RCPS at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 is infeasible with n = 24 n=24 . paragraphs.en: H6 is not supported: the transfer gap behaves as Identity 1 predicts, not as a uniform optimism, and the secondary hypothesis on UCCD failed for the same reason. H8 is supported, and the spread of the exceedance over calibration sets matches Lemma 1 .
paragraphs.zh: H6 不受支持：转移间隙的表现符合智能体 1 的预测，而非均匀乐观预期，并且关于 UCCD 的次要假设也因相同原因而失败。 H8 得到支持，且超越值在校准集上的分布与引理 1 一致。

paragraphs.en: With geometry gated and operating points explicit, the residual models should still differ in ways that hold across operating points for some metrics but not others. Where pooled and subject-mean Dice disagree, Identity 2 predicts that the method gaining more from pooling is the one whose Dice is concentrated in subjects with large p i + G i p_{i}+G_{i} . The contrasts are tested in declared families with Holm adjustment.
paragraphs.zh: 在几何结构受门控限制且工作点明确的情况下，残差模型在某些指标上仍应在不同工作点之间保持一致的差异，但在其他指标上则未必如此。 当池化 Dice 与个体均值 Dice 不一致时，Identity 2 预测：从池化中获益更多的那一种方法，其 Dice 值会集中在 p_i + G_i 较大的个体中。 这些对比在声明的族内通过 Holm 调整进行检验。

paragraphs.en: With the evaluation made explicit the residual models can be compared (Fig. 8 ; Appendix 0.D.4 , Table 33 ). At small budgets UCCD and cDDPM achieve higher Dice than REFLECT, also at equal burden: REFLECT − - UCCD was − 0.200 ​ [ − 0.219 , − 0.180 ] -0.200\,[-0.219,\,-0.180] at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} and − 0.118 ​ [ − 0.209 , − 0.048 ] -0.118\,[-0.209,\,-0.048] at equal burden (both p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 ). At 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} the sign depended on the aggregation (mean − 0.042 -0.042 , median − 0.008 -0.008 , pooled + 0.020 +0.020 ). At 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} pooled, REFLECT led by + 0.056 ​ [ 0.038 , 0.073 ] +0.056\,[0.038,\,0.073] at the validation threshold and + 0.060 +0.060 at equal burden (both p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 ). Identity 2 gives the mechanism: pooling raises a method’s Dice above its subject mean in proportion to the covariance between D i \mathrm{D}_{i} and the weight p i + G i p_{i}+G_{i} (Eq. 17 ). At 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} pooling lifted REFLECT by 0.071 0.071 ( 0.497 → 0.568 0.497\to 0.568 ) but UCCD by only 0.009 0.009 ( 0.539 → 0.548 0.539\to 0.548 ), so REFLECT’s Dice is concentrated in the subjects that carry the most weight. For a typical subject, as measured by the median, REFLECT and UCCD were not distinguishable at 20 or 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} after adjustment ( p H p_{\mathrm{H}} from 0.14 to 1.00), whereas REFLECT − - cDDPM at 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} was + 0.055 ​ [ 0.029 , 0.079 ] +0.055\,[0.029,\,0.079] in the median as well.
paragraphs.zh: 通过明确评估，可以比较剩余模型（图 8；附录 0.D.4，表 33）。 在低预算下，UCCD 和 cDDPM 实现的 Dice 值高于 REFLECT，在负担相同时也是如此：在 5 cm³ 时，REFLECT − UCCD 为 −0.200 [−0.219, −0.180]；在负担相同时为 −0.118 [−0.209, −0.048]（两者均 p_H < 0.005）。 在 20 cm³ 时，符号取决于聚合方式（均值 −0.042，中位数 −0.008，合并值 +0.020）。 在 40 cm³ 时，合并后的 REFLECT 在验证阈值处领先 +0.056 [0.038, 0.073]，在负担相同时领先 +0.060（两者均 p_H < 0.005）。 恒等式 2 揭示了其机制：聚合会将方法本身的 Dice 值提升至高于其受试者均值，提升幅度与 D_i 和权重 p_i + G_i 之间的协方差成正比（方程 17）。 在 20 cm³ 时，聚合使 REFLECT 提升了 0.071（从 0.497 到 0.568），但 UCCD 仅提升了 0.009（从 0.539 到 0.548），因此 REFLECT 的 Dice 值主要集中在权重最大的受试者中。 对于以中位数为衡量标准的典型受试者，在调整后的 20 cm³ 或 40 cm³ 条件下，REFLECT 和 UCCD 无法区分（p_H 从 0.14 到 1.00）；而在 40 cm³ 时，REFLECT − cDDPM 的中位数也为 +0.055 [0.029, 0.079]。

paragraphs.en: Threshold-free metrics gave a stable order (Table 6 ). REFLECT had the highest voxel AUROC in every universe and every configuration set: 0.932 0.932 against 0.865 0.865 (UCCD), 0.873 0.873 (cDDPM) and 0.832 0.832 (AnomalyDINO), with paired contrasts of + 0.067 ​ [ 0.060 , 0.074 ] +0.067\,[0.060,\,0.074] and + 0.059 ​ [ 0.051 , 0.066 ] +0.059\,[0.051,\,0.066] over the two diffusion models. Medians exceeded means for every residual model, reflecting left-skewed per-subject distributions with a tail of hard subjects. Pooling lowered AUPRC for UCCD and cDDPM but raised it for REFLECT, so the AUPRC order depends on the aggregation. AnomalyDINO was last in every universe of every metric. The comparison is consistent with the hypothesis: the voxel-AUROC order is stable, the Dice order depends on the budget and the aggregation, and the direction of the aggregation effect is the one Identity 2 predicts.

paragraphs.en: Identity 5 implies that a post-processing gain measured at equal burden may come largely from relaxing the plain threshold rather than from the post-processing itself, and Identity 4 that deleting low-purity components raises Dice whilst removing small true lesions. Secondary hypotheses made this concrete: for UCCD at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} the relaxation term is positive, excludes zero and exceeds the fixed-threshold term; for AnomalyDINO the total gain is at most zero; and above-floor sensitivity falls with post-processing for UCCD and AnomalyDINO. H5 (pruning trade-off): pruning helps lesion detection at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} and hurts it at 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} .
paragraphs.zh: 恒等式 5 表明，在相同负担下测得的后处理增益可能主要源于放宽简单阈值，而非后处理本身；而恒等式 4 表明，删除低纯度成分会提高 Dice 系数，但同时也会移除较小的真实病变。 次要假设对此进行了具体化：对于体积为 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 的 UCCD，放宽项为正数、排除零且超过固定阈值项；对于 AnomalyDINO，总增益最多为零；而对于 UCCD 和 AnomalyDINO，高于基线的灵敏度会随后处理而下降。 H5（剪枝权衡）：剪枝有助于在 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时检测病变，但在 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时则会阻碍病变检测。

paragraphs.en: Hysteresis with persistence pruning raised Dice at equal realised burden for the three residual models, but almost all of the gain came from the burden it freed (Table 7 , Fig. 9 ). For UCCD at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} the total of + 0.085 +0.085 split into + 0.006 ​ [ − 0.004 , 0.016 ] +0.006\,[-0.004,\,0.016] from post-processing at fixed threshold and + 0.078 ​ [ 0.073 , 0.083 ] +0.078\,[0.073,\,0.083] from relaxing the plain threshold, as predicted: 92% of the gain is relaxation. For REFLECT the step itself lowered Dice ( − 0.013 ​ [ − 0.022 , − 0.005 ] -0.013\,[-0.022,\,-0.005] ) and relaxation supplied + 0.046 +0.046 . For AnomalyDINO the total was null, − 0.001 ​ [ − 0.011 , 0.010 ] -0.001\,[-0.011,\,0.010] , again as predicted. The step also removed lesions: above-floor sensitivity fell from 0.674 to 0.629 (UCCD), 0.665 to 0.619 (cDDPM), 0.608 to 0.549 (REFLECT) and 0.210 to 0.121 (AnomalyDINO), and small-lesion sensitivity fell to 0.000 for REFLECT. The purity rule explains why: between 73.5% (AnomalyDINO) and 82.5% (UCCD) of predicted components had purity t ′ / p ′ < D / 2 t^{\prime}/p^{\prime}<\mathrm{D}/2 , so deleting them raises Dice, and components that contain small lesions are amongst them. H5 was not supported: the detection effect was negative at both budgets for every method with Dice ≥ 0.3 \geq 0.3 (point estimates only; no interval was computed for this measure). The three secondary hypotheses held. Results at every budget are in Appendix 0.D.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在三个残差模型中，结合持续剪枝的滞后效应使实现负担相等时 Dice 值有所提升，但几乎所有增益都来自由此释放的负担（表 7，图 9）。 对于 UCCD 在 20 cm³ 的情况，总增益 +0.085 分解为：固定阈值下后处理带来的 +0.006 [−0.004, 0.016]，以及放宽原始阈值带来的 +0.078 [0.073, 0.083]，与预测一致：92% 的增益来自阈值放宽。 对于 REFLECT，该步骤本身降低了 Dice 值（−0.013 [−0.022, −0.005]），而阈值放宽则带来了 +0.046 的增益。 对于 AnomalyDINO，总效应为零，即 −0.001 [−0.011, 0.010]，同样符合预测。 该步骤还移除了病变：高于基线的敏感度从 0.674 降至 0.629（UCCD）、从 0.665 降至 0.619（cDDPM）、从 0.608 降至 0.549（REFLECT），以及从 0.210 降至 0.121（AnomalyDINO）；而小病变敏感度在 REFLECT 中降至 0.000。 纯度规则解释了原因：在预测成分中，有 73.5%（AnomalyDINO）至 82.5%（UCCD）的成分纯度 t′/p′ < D/2，因此删除它们会提高 Dice 值，而这些成分中也包含含有小病变的成分。 H5 未得到支持：在所有方法中，当 Dice ≥ 0.3 时，两种预算下的检测效应均为负值（仅点估计；该指标未计算置信区间）。 三个次要假设均成立。 各预算下的结果见附录 0.D.5。

paragraphs.en: Tumours sit in large mid-brain slices, so a slice-level score may reward a map for tracking how much brain a slice contains. H9 (anatomy adjustment): if covariate adjustment removes this anatomy, a scorer that sees only brain area obtains a matched AROC within 0.50 ± 0.02 0.50\pm 0.02 . A secondary hypothesis predicts that UCCD and AnomalyDINO retain subject-specific information, with observed minus borrowed-map AROC above zero.
paragraphs.zh: 肿瘤位于大脑中部的较大切片中，因此切片级别的评分可能会奖励能够追踪切片包含多少脑组织的映射。 H9（解剖学调整）：如果协变量调整移除了这种解剖结构，那么仅能观察到脑面积的评分器可在 0.50 ± 0.02 的范围内获得匹配的 AROC。 一个次要假设预测，UCCD 和 AnomalyDINO 会保留与受试者相关的特定信息，其观察值减去借用映射后的 AROC 将大于零。

paragraphs.en: A scorer that knows only how much brain a slice contains reached a marginal slice AUROC of 0.884 ​ [ 0.869 , 0.897 ] 0.884\,[0.869,\,0.897] , within 0.025 of every residual model ( 0.887 0.887 to 0.907 0.907 ; Table 8 , Fig. 10 ). Covariate adjustment lowered the residual models to 0.73–0.77, but it did not remove anatomy entirely: at the primary caliper of 0.2 standard deviations the brain-area control still scored 0.668 ​ [ 0.654 , 0.682 ] 0.668\,[0.654,\,0.682] , so H9 was not supported, and 0.560 at 0.05. The spline-regression estimator also failed its own control (0.626 with 5 degrees of freedom, 0.719 with 8). The obstacle is positivity: tumour slices sit in large mid-brain slices, so within a subject there are few negative slices of comparable area, and matching kept only 59% of positives at 0.2 SD and 46% at 0.05 SD. The borrowed-map contrast avoids the problem by changing the scores rather than the comparison set: every model retained subject-specific information, observed minus borrowed AROC being + 0.229 +0.229 (REFLECT), + 0.266 +0.266 (UCCD), + 0.271 +0.271 (cDDPM) and + 0.124 +0.124 (AnomalyDINO), all intervals excluding zero, so the secondary hypothesis held, for the other two models as well. The marginal order (UCCD > > cDDPM > > REFLECT) also differs from the voxel-AUROC order. Intervals for every estimator and the dependence on the caliper are given in Appendix 0.D.6 .

paragraphs.en: If no sub-floor fragment is ever hit, the lesion floor changes pooled sensitivity only through its denominator, by the ratio | ℒ f | / | ℒ 0 | |\mathcal{L}_{f}|/|\mathcal{L}_{0}| (Appendix 0.A ). paragraphs.en: At the validation threshold the residual models found nearly every large lesion and almost no small one: large-lesion sensitivity was 0.915 to 0.997 and small-lesion sensitivity 0.036 to 0.073, at most 12 of 165 small lesions, as the secondary hypothesis predicted. The three residual models missed largely the same lesions (Jaccard index of the missed sets 0.805 to 0.938), which supports the second secondary hypothesis. Most misses carried evidence that the threshold did not select: of the 472 above-floor lesions, 123 to 137 were missed with in-lesion scores above the subject’s healthy-brain median, 9 to 17 had no such evidence, and 12 to 35 were selected but delineated with IoU < 0.10 <0.10 (Fig. 11 a). Lesion volume dominated detection in every model (Firth-penalised log-odds 4.8 to 6.0 per standard deviation of log volume for the residual models; Fig. 11 b), whereas in the Firth fit T2 contrast added an effect whose interval excluded zero only for REFLECT ( + 1.98 ​ [ 1.22 , 2.82 ] +1.98\,[1.22,\,2.82] ) and AnomalyDINO ( + 0.29 ​ [ 0.03 , 0.55 ] +0.29\,[0.03,\,0.55] ); for cDDPM only the GEE interval excluded zero (Appendix Table 47 ). H4 was therefore not supported; it could be tested only in part, because oedema fractions are not available in the binary labels. Label-informed upper bounds that respect the per-subject budget (Appendix 0.D.7 , Table 45 ) place the remaining headroom mainly in delineation: perfect boundaries for detected lesions would add 0.40 to 0.46 Dice at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} , an optimal threshold per lesion 0.12 to 0.16, and an optimal threshold per subject 0.03 to 0.07.
paragraphs.zh: 在验证阈值下，残差模型几乎检测到了所有大病变，但几乎没有检测到小病变：大病变的敏感性为 0.915 至 0.997，而小病变的敏感性仅为 0.036 至 0.073，最多仅检测到 165 个小病变中的 12 个，这与第二个次级假设的预测一致。 三个残差模型遗漏的病变基本相同（被遗漏集合的雅可比指数为 0.805 至 0.938），这支持了第二个次级假设。 大多数漏检病例表明阈值未将其选中：在 472 个高于基线的病变中，有 123 至 137 个因病变内评分低于受试者健康脑部的中位数而被遗漏；9 至 17 个没有此类证据；另有 12 至 35 个被选中，但交联_union（IoU）< 0.10 <0.10（图 11a）。 在所有模型中，病变体积对检测起主导作用（对于残差模型，经 Firth 惩罚的对数赔率比为每标准差对数体积增加 4.8 至 6.0；图 11b）；而在 Firth 拟合中，T2 对比仅在 REFLECT（+1.98 [1.22, 2.82] +1.98\,[1.22,\,2.82]）和 AnomalyDINO（+0.29 [0.03, 0.55] +0.29\,[0.03,\,0.55]）中产生了排除零的效应区间；对于 cDDPM，仅 GEE 区间排除了零（附录表 47）。 因此，H4 未得到支持；由于二元标签中不包含水肿比例，该假设只能部分检验。 尊重每位受试者预算的、基于标签的上限（附录 0.D.7，表 45）表明，剩余的提升空间主要存在于病变勾画中：若对已检测到的病变实现完美边界，在 20 cm³（20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}）时可将 Dice 系数提升 0.40 至 0.46；每个病变的最优阈值可达 0.12 至 0.16，每位受试者的最优阈值为 0.03 至 0.07。

paragraphs.en: Thresholding raw intensity has been reported to rival learnt detectors [ 48 ] . H3 (intensity baseline): z-scored T2 comes within 0.05 Dice of at least one model at equal realised burden at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . Identity 3 adds an exploratory prediction: a score normalised per subject, such as z-scored FLAIR, can rank voxels well within subjects yet pool poorly.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究指出，对原始强度进行阈值处理的效果可与学习型检测器相媲美 [48]。 H3（强度基线）：z-分数化的 T2 在 20 cm³ 的实际负担相等时，与至少一个模型的 Dice 系数差异在 0.05 以内。 Identity 3 增加了一项探索性预测：按受试者归一化的分数（例如 z-分数化的 FLAIR）可以在受试者内部对体素进行良好排序，但在跨受试者汇总时效果不佳。

sents.zh: 已有研究指出，对原始强度进行阈值处理的效果可与学习型检测器相媲美 [48]。

paragraphs.en: Every model, AnomalyDINO included, beat z-scored T2 intensity in Dice at matched burden at every budget: the residual models by 0.28 to 0.46 across budgets (0.44 to 0.46 at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ) and AnomalyDINO by 0.098 ​ [ 0.076 , 0.119 ] 0.098\,[0.076,\,0.119] at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} so H3 was not supported. FLAIR, which the models never see, exceeded each of the three residual models in subject-mean voxel AUROC and AUPRC, but not when voxels were pooled, and never in Dice; it exceeded AnomalyDINO in every metric and aggregation (Fig. 12 ). For REFLECT the voxel-AUROC difference reversed sign with the aggregation, + 0.018 ​ [ 0.009 , 0.027 ] +0.018\,[0.009,\,0.027] in the subject mean and − 0.071 ​ [ − 0.085 , − 0.057 ] -0.071\,[-0.085,\,-0.057] pooled, both p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 . Identity 3 suggests a reading: per-subject z-scoring makes FLAIR rank voxels well within each subject, but the between-subject term of Eq. ( 19 ) penalises its uncalibrated scale across subjects. AnomalyDINO was indistinguishable from raw T2 in voxel AUROC ( + 0.005 ​ [ − 0.006 , 0.016 ] +0.005\,[-0.006,\,0.016] , T2 minus model). All baseline contrasts, at every budget and aggregation, are listed in Appendix 0.D.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 在所有预算水平下，包括 AnomalyDINO 在内的每个模型在匹配病变负荷的 Dice 指标上均优于 z-分数处理的 T2 强度：残差模型的优势在各类预算中为 0.28 至 0.46（在 20 cm³ [20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}] 时为 0.44 至 0.46），而 AnomalyDINO 的优势为 0.098 [0.076, 0.119]，因此 H3 假设未得到支持。FLAIR 是模型从未接触过的数据，在受试者均值体素 AUROC 和 AUPRC 上超过了三种残差模型中的每一种，但在体素合并后则不再如此，且从未在 Dice 指标上超越它们；它在所有指标和聚合方式上都优于 AnomalyDINO（图 12）。对于 REFLECT，体素-AUROC 的差异随着聚合方式的改变而符号反转：在受试者均值中为 +0.018 [0.009, 0.027]，在合并后则为 −0.071 [−0.085, −0.057]，两者均满足 p_H < 0.005。Identity 3 提示了一种解释：按受试者进行 z-分数处理使 FLAIR 在每个受试者内部对体素的排序表现良好，但方程 (19) 中的受试者间项惩罚了其跨受试者的未校准尺度。在体素 AUROC 上，AnomalyDINO 与原始 T2 数据无显著差异（+0.005 [−0.006, 0.016]，T2 减去模型）。所有基线对比结果，涵盖各类预算和聚合方式，均列于附录 0.D.8。

paragraphs.en: If the healthy training data were a neutral background to a comparison of methods, giving every method the same alternative training set should leave the contrasts between methods unchanged. And if a training set could be chosen per method from validation data, the choice should be stable under resampling of the 24 validation subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 如果健康的训练数据是方法比较中的中性背景，那么为每种方法提供相同的替代训练集应该会使方法之间的对比保持不变。 并且，如果可以为每种方法从验证数据中选择一个训练集，那么该选择应该在 24 名验证受试者重新采样时保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Holding the evaluation fixed and giving all four methods the same alternative training set reversed a significant contrast (Fig. 13 a). REFLECT − - UCCD Dice was − 0.042 ​ [ − 0.060 , − 0.025 ] -0.042\,[-0.060,\,-0.025] with all methods trained on IXI-HH+Guys and + 0.100 ​ [ 0.079 , 0.121 ] +0.100\,[0.079,\,0.121] with all trained on MOOD+IXI, both p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 . The method × \times training-set interaction carried 0.115 of Dice variance across the five training sets, and the four-method order differed from the IXI-HH+Guys order in 50% to 92% of defensible universes, depending on the comparison set. The MOOD+IXI comparison needs a caveat: it adds T1 data for every method, and cDDPM’s MOOD+IXI training set was 72% T1, so it compares the same sources with multi-contrast training. The comparison on IXI-HH+Guys is the clean one.

paragraphs.en: Choosing a training set per method on 24 validation subjects was itself unstable (Fig. 13 b). The primary selection rule (median validation slice Dice) chose IXI-HH+Guys for REFLECT in only 36.8% of 10 4 10^{4} bootstrap resamples (MOOD+IXI 37.9%, MOOD+IXI-HH 22.8%), at a test regret of 0.055 Dice. Across resamples each rule produced between 27 and 137 distinct joint choices for the four methods, and the most frequent joint choice never exceeded 37.5%. Both hypotheses are therefore rejected, which is the empirical case for fixing a common training set by design, as we did. H1 and H2 held with every common training set (Appendix 0.E ). All twenty method–training-set combinations and the verdicts of the hypotheses with each set of training data are in Appendix 0.E .
paragraphs.zh: 在 24 名验证受试者上按方法选择训练集本身就不稳定（图 13b）。 主要选择规则（验证切片 Dice 中位数）在 10^4 次自助重采样中，仅有 36.8% 的情况下为 REFLECT 选择了 IXI-HH+Guys（MOOD+IXI 为 37.9%，MOOD+IXI-HH 为 22.8%），此时测试遗憾值为 0.055 Dice。 在所有重采样中，每种规则都为四种方法生成了 27 到 137 种不同的联合选择，而最频繁的联合选择从未超过 37.5%。 因此，这两个假设均被拒绝，这也从经验上支持了我们通过设计固定一个通用训练集的做法。 在所有通用训练集中，H1 和 H2 均成立（附录 0.E）。 所有二十种方法–训练集组合，以及每种训练数据集下各假设的判定结果，均见附录 0.E。

paragraphs.en: REFLECT’s four latent channels need not agree on where an anomaly lies, and its published map averages them. If their disagreement carries signal, aggregating the channels by it should sharpen the map and raise Dice at equal burden. The median absolute deviation across channels (MAD) is retained as the recommended aggregation only if its interval does not overlap that of the best other aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: REFLECT 的四个潜在通道不必对异常位置达成一致，其发布的地图会取这些通道的平均值。 如果它们之间的分歧携带有效信号，那么据此聚合各通道应该能锐化地图，并在相同负担下提高 Dice 系数。 仅当跨通道的中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的置信区间与其他最佳聚合方法的置信区间不重叠时，才会保留 MAD 作为推荐的聚合方法。

paragraphs.en: Replacing REFLECT’s published map by the fusion of Eq. ( 27 ) raised Dice at equal burden in two independently trained models (Fig. 14 ). At its own validation threshold, which is what a user would obtain, MAD reached 0.544 ​ [ 0.521 , 0.566 ] 0.544\,[0.521,\,0.566] (median 0.597) at 15.3 ​ cm 3 15.3\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} realised burden against 0.492 ​ [ 0.468 , 0.516 ] 0.492\,[0.468,\,0.516] for the published map (median 0.542) at 15.7 ​ cm 3 15.7\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (on the 0.01 threshold grid used for this study, hence the small difference from Table 4 ), with above-floor sensitivity 0.631 against 0.606. The retention criterion kept MAD ahead of the next-best aggregation in 10 of 16 settings for the IXI-HH+Guys model, including the primary setting, but in only 5 of 16 for the MOOD+IXI model, where it lost the primary setting. We therefore claim the family of results (latent aggregation helps, latent-only scoring hurts, the image stream beats the published fusion), not MAD in particular. paragraphs.en: The same four models produced different winners in four distinct ways. The metric decides whether REFLECT or a conditioned diffusion model leads. The aggregation decides it again at a fixed budget, and Identity 2 explains the direction. The operating point turns an advantage of UCCD over cDDPM that is significant after Holm adjustment into nothing once both are held to the same realised burden, and Identity 1 accounts for the whole difference as a difference in threshold transfer. And the training data, changed in the same way for every method, reverses a significant contrast. None of these is exotic. Each corresponds to a decision that a typical UAD paper takes once, silently, and reports as though it were not a decision at all.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的四个模型以四种不同的方式产生了不同的获胜者。 该指标决定的是 REFLECT 还是条件扩散模型能够领先。 聚合过程在固定预算下再次做出决定，而 Identity 2 则解释了其方向。 运行点将 UCCD 相对于 cDDPM 的一个优势——在 Holm 调整之后原本显著的优势——转化为无足轻重，一旦两者被限制到相同的实际负担；而 Identity 1 则将整个差异归因于阈值转移的差异。 此外，以相同方式为每种方法更改的训练数据逆转了显著的对比。这些情况中没有任何一个是罕见的。 每一种情况都对应于典型的 UAD 论文在一次操作中默默做出的决定，并且报告时仿佛这根本不是一个决定。

paragraphs.en: Registration gating is the least visible component and, in this study, the one with the largest single effect: an axis-order mismatch cut a diffusion model’s voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583, whilst slice-level AUROC, a widely reported detection metric, barely changed. Such mismatches are not peculiar to one pipeline; three arose in assembling this benchmark, each yielding a plausible table. Any evaluation that compares methods with different preprocessing must map their outputs into a common space, and slice-level scores are invariant to precisely the in-plane permutations that wreck localisation. The registration gate and the label-free diagnostics catch such errors with measured power and leave correct pipelines alone; the obvious alternative, a Dice threshold on the method’s own reference, would have rejected up to 242 correctly registered subjects per method.
paragraphs.zh: 配准门控是最不显眼的环节，但在本研究中也产生了最大的单一影响：轴序不匹配将扩散模型的体素 AUROC 从 0.873 降至 0.583，而广泛使用的检测指标——切片级 AUROC 却几乎没有变化。 这类不匹配并非某个流程所特有；在构建本基准时出现了三种不匹配情况，每种都生成了一份看似合理的表格。 任何比较不同预处理方法的评价都必须将其输出映射到共同空间，而切片级分数恰恰对破坏定位的平面内置换保持不变。 配准门控和无标签诊断方法能够以可测量的效力捕捉此类错误，同时不影响正确的流程；而另一种显而易见的替代方案——对方法自身参考应用 Dice 阈值——则会在每种方法中拒绝多达 242 个正确配准的受试者。

paragraphs.en: The threshold-transfer component turns a familiar complaint, that thresholds are tuned on the test set, into something measurable. Identity 1 shows that the gap between test-tuned and validation-tuned Dice is not a fixed optimism to be subtracted but a product of a burden mismatch and a local slope, which differs from method to method. A comparison at validation thresholds reflects what a user would obtain but confounds map quality with threshold transfer; a comparison at equal burden isolates map quality but cannot be reproduced in practice. MIRTO reports both, and the identity says exactly how they relate. Conformal risk control adds a per-scan guarantee, which is closer to what matters for an individual patient than a cohort mean. The known training-conditional law of Lemma 1 adds the caveat that a 24-subject calibration set honours the guarantee only on average, with a spread that follows from the calibration size alone, and the empirical splits followed that law closely (shares within 2.8 percentage points, 97.5th percentiles within 0.015). A user who needs the guarantee for the calibration set in hand should use RCPS or Learn-then-Test [ 8 , 1 ] and accept a stricter threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 阈值转移组件将一种常见的抱怨——即阈值是在测试集上调整的——转化为可量化的问题。 恒等式 1 表明，测试集调整与验证集调整得到的 Dice 系数之间的差距并非一个需要扣除的固定乐观值，而是负担不匹配与局部斜率共同作用的结果，而这一斜率因方法不同而异。 在验证阈值上的比较反映了用户可能获得的结果，但会将地图质量与阈值转移混为一谈；而在相同负担下的比较则能孤立出地图质量，但在实践中无法复现。 MIRTO 同时报告了这两种情况，而该恒等式精确说明了它们之间的关系。 共形风险控制增加了一项每次扫描的保证，这种保证对于个体患者而言比群体均值更为重要。 引理 1 中已知的训练条件定律补充说明：一个包含 24 个受试者的校准集仅在平均意义上满足该保证，其波动范围完全由校准集规模决定，而实际的经验性划分也严格遵循了这一定律（差异在 2.8 个百分点以内，97.5% 分位数差异在 0.015 以内）。 若用户需要针对当前校准集的保证，则应使用 RCPS 或“先学习后测试”方法 [8, 1]，并接受更严格的阈值。

sents.en: The threshold-transfer component turns a familiar complaint, that thresholds are tuned on the test set, into something measurable.
sents.zh: 阈值转移组件将一种常见的抱怨——即阈值是在测试集上调整的——转化为可量化的问题。

sents.en: Identity 1 shows that the gap between test-tuned and validation-tuned Dice is not a fixed optimism to be subtracted but a product of a burden mismatch and a local slope, which differs from method to method.
sents.zh: 恒等式 1 表明，测试集调整与验证集调整得到的 Dice 系数之间的差距并非一个需要扣除的固定乐观值，而是负担不匹配与局部斜率共同作用的结果，而这一斜率因方法不同而异。

sents.en: A comparison at validation thresholds reflects what a user would obtain but confounds map quality with threshold transfer; a comparison at equal burden isolates map quality but cannot be reproduced in practice.
sents.zh: 在验证阈值上的比较反映了用户可能获得的结果，但会将地图质量与阈值转移混为一谈；而在相同负担下的比较则能孤立出地图质量，但在实践中无法复现。

sents.en: MIRTO reports both, and the identity says exactly how they relate.
sents.zh: MIRTO 同时报告了这两种情况，而该恒等式精确说明了它们之间的关系。

sents.en: Conformal risk control adds a per-scan guarantee, which is closer to what matters for an individual patient than a cohort mean.
sents.zh: 共形风险控制增加了一项每次扫描的保证，这种保证对于个体患者而言比群体均值更为重要。

sents.en: The known training-conditional law of Lemma 1 adds the caveat that a 24-subject calibration set honours the guarantee only on average, with a spread that follows from the calibration size alone, and the empirical splits followed that law closely (shares within 2.8 percentage points, 97.5th percentiles within 0.015).
sents.zh: 引理 1 中已知的训练条件定律补充说明：一个包含 24 个受试者的校准集仅在平均意义上满足该保证，其波动范围完全由校准集规模决定，而实际的经验性划分也严格遵循了这一定律（差异在 2.8 个百分点以内，97.5% 分位数差异在 0.015 以内）。

sents.en: A user who needs the guarantee for the calibration set in hand should use RCPS or Learn-then-Test [ 8 , 1 ] and accept a stricter threshold.
sents.zh: 若用户需要针对当前校准集的保证，则应使用 RCPS 或“先学习后测试”方法 [8, 1]，并接受更严格的阈值。

paragraphs.en: The multiverse quantifies what the previous components illustrate, and it is most informative metric by metric. Pooled over metrics, the evaluation axes carry most of the variance, but mainly because metrics have different scales, and we do not lean on that share. Within a metric the picture is sharper. Rankings by voxel AUROC are a property of the method. Dice is dominated by the method in variance, chiefly because one method is far behind, yet the order of the three residual models is decided by the evaluation, with leads of several Dice points in each direction and significant contrasts on both sides. Lesion sensitivity is mostly a property of the evaluation. Reading flip shares together with the size of each difference is what separates these cases from mere closeness: UCCD and cDDPM swap places often because they are close, and their significant difference at validation thresholds is a matter of threshold transfer. Lesion-level claims deserve the least confidence unless the lesion definition, the hit criterion and the floor are stated, and our denominator identity shows that the floor alone can change sensitivity elevenfold without a single hit changing.
paragraphs.zh: 多宇宙量化了先前各组成部分所说明的内容，并且从指标到指标都具有极高的信息价值。 在多个指标上汇总后，评估维度承载了大部分方差，但这主要是因为各指标的量纲不同，而我们又未依赖这一部分。 在单个指标内部，情况则更为清晰。 基于体素 AUROC 的排名是该方法固有的特性。 在方差方面，Dice 系数主要由方法决定，这主要是因为其中一种方法表现远落后；然而，其余三种模型之间的顺序则由评估结果决定，每个方向上均有数个百分点的差距，且两侧均存在显著差异。 病灶敏感度在很大程度上是评估本身的特性。 结合翻转率与每个差异的大小来解读，才能将这些案例与单纯的“接近”区分开来：UCCD 和 cDDPM 之所以经常互换位置，是因为它们彼此接近；而它们在验证阈值上的显著差异实际上源于阈值的转移。 除非明确说明病灶定义、命中标准以及下限，否则对病灶层面的结论应给予最低限度的置信度；我们的分母身份分析表明，仅通过改变下限，敏感度就可能发生十一倍的变动，而无需任何一次命中结果发生变化。

paragraphs.en: For authors of UAD methods we suggest a short list, which the checklist released with the code expands. Score every method against one reference on one grid, and report a registration check. Choose thresholds on data that are not the test set, and report the realised false-positive burden as a distribution (median and 95th percentile, not only the mean). Report subject mean, median and pooled Dice side by side, and when two methods swap places across evaluation choices, report by how much each leads. State the lesion definition in full. Do not report marginal slice AUROC without an anatomy control. Report paired intervals with a declared multiplicity correction. And train competing methods on the same healthy data, or say plainly that they were not.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 UAD 方法的作者，我们建议提供一个简短的清单，该清单会随代码一同发布的检查表将进一步扩展。 对每种方法基于一个参考在单个网格上进行评分，并报告注册检查结果。 在非测试集的数据上选择阈值，并以分布形式（中位数和第 95 百分位数，而非仅平均值）报告实际实现的假阳性负担。 并列报告受试者的均值、中位数和合并 Dice 系数；当两种方法在不同评估方案中的排名互换时，需报告各自领先的具体幅度。 完整说明病变的定义。 若无解剖学对照，请勿报告边缘切片的 AUROC。 报告配对区间，并声明已进行多重性校正。 并且应在相同健康数据上训练竞争性方法，或明确说明未这样做。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks have improved UAD evaluation by enlarging and diversifying the test data [ 28 ] , by examining the normative reconstruction [ 16 ] , or by unifying many methods and datasets within one framework [ 40 , 6 , 18 ] . MIRTO is complementary. It does not propose a new dataset; it asks how much of any benchmark’s conclusion survives a change of defensible evaluation choices, and it provides the identities needed to say why a conclusion changes when it does. The same machinery could be wrapped around any of those benchmarks. It also answers, for UAD, the concerns raised for medical imaging AI in general: that performance variability and confidence intervals are rarely reported [ 23 ] , that many outperformance claims are probably false [ 22 ] , and that biases enter at every step of evaluation [ 63 ] . MIRTO adds a source of uncertainty that intervals over subjects do not capture, the choice of evaluation pipeline, and shows how large it is.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基准测试通过扩大和多样化测试数据 [28]、检验规范重建 [16]，或将多种方法和数据集统一到一个框架中 [40, 6, 18]，提升了 UAD 评估的效果。MIRTO 则与之互补。 它并未提出新的数据集；而是探讨在改变合理的评估选项时，任何基准测试的结论能在多大程度上保持不变，并提供说明结论变化原因所需的具体信息。 同样的机制也可以应用于上述任何基准测试。 对于 UAD，MIRTO 还回应了医学影像人工智能领域普遍存在的担忧：性能波动和置信区间很少被报告 [23]，许多声称优于其他方法的结论可能并不成立 [22]，并且偏见会出现在评估的每一步骤中 [63]。 MIRTO 引入了一个区间无法涵盖的不确定性来源——评估流程的选择，并展示了这种不确定性的大小。

paragraphs.en: The evidence comes from a single cohort and a single contrast. BraTS 2020 whole-tumour labels are large, conspicuous lesions, and evaluation on T2 alone limits what can be said about small or subtle pathology; the small-lesion results here are a floor, not a characterisation. The 312 test subjects served both to develop the protocol and the choice of training set and to test the hypotheses, so all inference is exploratory; explicit decision criteria keep a hypothesis from being bent to fit its outcome, but they cannot remove the influence of other analyses of the same cohort. One trained model exists per method and training set, so training-seed variance, which can be large enough to change benchmark conclusions [ 17 ] and is the most likely competing explanation for small between-method differences, is unknown. A common training set means the same source data, not the same optimisation budget, and IXI-HH+Guys is not the best training set for every method: on test it cost REFLECT 0.055 and UCCD 0.037 Dice relative to their best training sets (Appendix Table 60 ), so the comparison of methods should not be read as each method’s best attainable result. The injection study validated the diagnostics on two pipelines; their power on other architectures is assumed rather than shown. Validation-threshold intervals do not include the uncertainty of fitting a threshold on 24 subjects, which a nested resampling would add. The covariate-adjusted slice estimators failed their own control, so the borrowed-map contrast, not the adjusted AUROC, is the defensible slice-level measure. Finally, the training-free improvement to REFLECT is shown for one method and two trained models, and the specific winning aggregation did not replicate.
paragraphs.zh: 该证据仅来自一个队列和一次对比。 BraTS 2020 的全肿瘤标签对应的是大且明显的病变，而仅基于 T2 的评估无法对微小或细微的病理情况做出有效判断；此处关于小病变的结果仅是一个下限，而非对其特征的完整描述。 这 312 名受试者既用于制定方案、选择训练集，也用于检验假设，因此所有推论均为探索性性质；明确的决策标准可防止为迎合结果而曲解假设，但无法消除对同一队列的其他分析所带来的影响。 每种方法和每个训练集仅对应一个训练好的模型，因此训练种子的变异程度尚不明确——这种变异可能足以改变基准测试的结论 [17]，并且很可能是解释方法间微小差异的最主要替代原因。 共享训练集意味着使用的是相同的数据源，而非相同的优化资源；IXI-HH+Guys 并非所有方法的最佳训练集：在测试中，与各自的最佳训练集相比，REFLECT 的 Dice 系数下降了 0.055，UCCD 下降了 0.037（见附录表 60），因此不应将这种方法比较解读为每种方法所能达到的最佳结果。 该注射研究在两种流程上验证了诊断模型；但它们在其他架构上的性能仅被假设，而非实际证明。 验证阈值区间并未包含基于 24 名受试者拟合阈值所带来的不确定性，而嵌套重采样会增加这种不确定性。 协变量调整后的切片估计器未能通过自身的对照测试，因此可被合理采纳的切片级指标是借用映射对比结果，而非调整后的 AUROC。 最后，REFLECT 无需训练即可实现的性能提升仅针对一种方法和两个训练好的模型进行了展示，且具体的获胜聚合方式并未得到重复验证。

paragraphs.en: The next step is a pre-registered confirmatory evaluation on an untouched cohort, with the training set and every threshold rule fixed by its protocol. Nested resampling of the validation threshold, several training seeds per method and a second pathology with smaller lesions would close the main gaps listed above.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步是在未经处理的队列上进行预先注册的确认性评估，其中训练集和所有阈值规则均按方案固定。 对验证阈值进行嵌套重采样、为每种方法使用多个训练种子，以及采用病变较小的第二种病理样本，将能填补上述列出的主要空白。

paragraphs.en: A UAD leaderboard is a statement about models and evaluation jointly. In our study the method decided rankings by voxel AUROC, whereas the evaluation decided the order of the three strongest models in Dice and in lesion sensitivity. MIRTO separates the two. It gates the geometry of the comparison with tests of known power, holds models to operating points chosen without the test set and reports what those operating points actually deliver, evaluates every conclusion over a multiverse of defensible pipelines, reading how often an order flips together with how large each difference is, and attaches paired, multiplicity-adjusted intervals to each claim. Elementary identities explain why a contrast changes between validation thresholds and matched burden, why post-processing appears to help and why pooled and subject-level rankings disagree, and a known conformal result states how often calibration on a small set will miss its target. Applied to four current UAD families, the protocol exposed a geometric error that standard metrics missed, showed which apparent differences were artefacts of threshold transfer, and still supported some definite statements for this cohort and training set: REFLECT had the highest voxel AUROC, the two conditioned diffusion models gave higher Dice at small budgets, no method found more than 12 of the 165 small lesions, and a training-free change to REFLECT’s latent aggregation raised its Dice at matched burden in two checkpoints. Reporting evaluation choices with the same care as architectures would make UAD comparisons much easier to interpret.
paragraphs.zh: UAD排行榜是对模型与评估联合结果的声明。 在我们的研究中，该方法通过体素AUROC决定排名，而评估则依据Dice和病变敏感度确定三个最强模型之间的顺序。MIRTO将这两者分离开来。 它通过已知功效的测试来调控比较的几何结构，使模型在未经测试集选择的运行点上运行，并报告这些运行点实际带来的结果；它在多种可辩护的流程组合中评估每一项结论，观察排名翻转的频率及差异的大小，并为每个结论附加经过多重性调整的成对置信区间。 基本恒等式解释了为何验证阈值与匹配负担之间的对比会发生变化，为何后处理看似有效，以及为何池化排名与个体级排名存在分歧；一个已知的保形结果还说明了在小数据集上进行校准时，其结果偏离目标的情况出现的频率。 该协议应用于当前的四种UAD模型家族，揭示了一种标准指标未能发现的几何误差，并展示了哪些表面差异是阈值转移造成的伪影；同时，它仍能为该队列和训练集提供一些明确结论：REFLECT的体素AUROC最高，两种条件扩散模型在小预算下获得了更高的Dice值，没有任何方法能检测到165个小型病变中的超过12个，而对REFLECT潜在聚合机制进行无需训练的修改，在两个检查点处提升了其在匹配负担下的Dice值。 若能像对待模型架构一样谨慎地报告评估选择，UAD比较将变得更容易解读。

paragraphs.en: This study is a secondary analysis of publicly released datasets; no new data were acquired and no participant was contacted. BraTS 2020 [ 49 , 4 , 5 ] was used under the organisers’ terms, which permit research use provided that the designated publications are cited. The IXI dataset [ 35 ] is distributed under the Creative Commons CC BY-SA 3.0 licence. The MOOD 2020 brain data [ 65 ] are publicly available on Hugging Face ( https://huggingface.co/datasets/dzimmerdkfz/mood_brain )Informed consent and ethical approval for data acquisition were obtained by the original studies, as described in the cited publications. The data must be obtained from their providers. Per-subject results underlying every table and figure are released with the code.
