paragraphs.en: The method pipelines’ own files declared voxel volumes of 0.8786 ​ mm 3 0.8786\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} (one shared grid), 1.166 ​ mm 3 1.166\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} (UCCD) and 0.604 ​ mm 3 0.604\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} (cDDPM) for grids whose true voxel was 1 ​ mm 3 1\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} or 0.8789 ​ mm 3 0.8789\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 in-plane). The same masks therefore produced burdens that differed by a factor of 1.93 1.93 between UCCD and cDDPM, and a nominal 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} meant 17.2 ​ cm 3 17.2\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} for one and 33.1 ​ cm 3 33.1\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} for the other. MIRTO recovers the true grid from voxel counts alone: the ratio of the tumour volume in those files, divided by the declared voxel volume, to the canonical voxel count is 1.0004 1.0004 for the 240-pixel grid and 1.1380 ≈ ( 256 / 240 ) 2 = 1.1378 1.1380\approx(256/240)^{2}=1.1378 for the 256-pixel grid. A round trip of the canonical reference through the UCCD/cDDPM native grid (2 mm in-plane, through-plane decimation) loses 57% of the 6-connected components, mostly sub-floor fragments, and 1.8% of tumour volume, whilst the REFLECT and AnomalyDINO grids lose 0.01–0.02% (Table 21 ). No MIRTO metric is computed on a method’s own resampled reference. Table 10 describes the cohort, and Tables 11 and 12 give the voxel-count check and its consequence for the budget.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法自身的文件所声明的体素体积分别为 0.8786 mm³（一个共享网格）、1.166 mm³（UCCD）和 0.604 mm³（cDDPM），而对应网格的真实体素体积为 1 mm³ 或 0.8789 mm³（256 × 256 的平面内分辨率）。 因此，相同的掩膜在 UCCD 和 cDDPM 之间产生了相差 1.93 倍的负担；标称的 20 cm³ 实际对应前者为 17.2 cm³，后者为 33.1 cm³。 MIRTO 仅通过体素计数即可恢复真实网格：在这些文件中，肿瘤体积与所声明的体素体积之比再除以标准体素计数，对于 240 像素网格为 1.0004，而对于 256 像素网格则为 1.1380 ≈ (256/240)² = 1.1378。 将标准参考数据通过 UCCD/cDDPM 原生网格（平面内分辨率为 2 mm，沿平面方向进行降采样）进行往返处理时，会损失 67% 的 6-连通成分（主要为亚地板碎片）和 1.8% 的肿瘤体积；而 REFLECT 和 AnomalyDINO 网格的损失则仅为 0.01–0.02%（见表 21）。 MIRTO 不会基于方法自身重采样的参考数据计算任何指标。 表 10 描述了该队列，表 11 和表 12 分别给出了体素计数检查结果及其对预算的影响。

paragraphs.en: For each above-floor lesion we model logit ​ ℙ ​ [ hit ℓ ] = β 0 + β 1 ​ z ℓ vol + β 2 ​ z ℓ con + β 3 ​ z ℓ pos + u i ⁡ ( ℓ ) \mathrm{logit}\mathbb{P}[\mathrm{hit}_{\ell}]=\beta_{0}+\beta_{1}z^{\mathrm{vol}}_{\ell}+\beta_{2}z^{\mathrm{con}}_{\ell}+\beta_{3}z^{\mathrm{pos}}_{\ell}+u_{i(\ell)} , with standardised log volume, T2 contrast (median T2 in the lesion over median T2 in normal-appearing brain on the same slices) and relative through-plane position, and a subject random intercept u i ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ u 2 ) u_{i}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{u}^{2}) . Because 472 lesions sit in 312 subjects (87 with more than one) and volume nearly separates hits from misses, the random intercept is weakly identified; we therefore also fit Firth-penalised logistic regression [ 27 ] , GEE with exchangeable working correlation [ 42 ] and a variational-Bayes GLMM, and report the Laplace fit of lme4 [ 7 ] . Firth, GEE and variational Bayes agree in sign and magnitude (log volume + 4.8 +4.8 to + 6.8 +6.8 per SD for the residual models); the Laplace fit did not converge for REFLECT.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个位于楼层以上的病变，我们将其逻辑回归模型定义为：logit ​ ℙ ​ [ hit ℓ ] = β 0 + β 1 ​ z ℓ vol + β 2 ​ z ℓ con + β 3 ​ z ℓ pos + u i ⁡ ( ℓ ) \mathrm{logit}\mathbb{P}[\mathrm{hit}_{\ell}]=\beta_{0}+\beta_{1}z^{\mathrm{vol}}_{\ell}+\beta_{2}z^{\mathrm{con}}_{\ell}+\beta_{3}z^{\mathrm{pos}}_{\ell}+u_{i(\ell)}，其中 z ℓ vol 表示标准化后的对数体积，z ℓ con 表示 T2 对比度（即病变区域的 T2 值中位数与同一切面上正常外观脑组织的 T2 值中位数之比），z ℓ pos 表示相对通过平面的位置，而 u i ⁡ ( ℓ ) 是受试者的随机截距项，满足 u i ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ u 2 ) u_{i}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{u}^{2})。 由于 472 个病变分布在 312 名受试者中（其中 87 名受试者有多个病变），且体积特征几乎能够区分出成功检测到的病变与未检测到的病变，因此随机截距项的估计较弱；为此，我们还拟合了 Firth 惩罚逻辑回归 [27]、具有可交换工作相关结构的 GEE 模型 [42] 以及变分贝叶斯 GLMM 模型，并报告了 lme4 [7] 的拉普拉斯拟合结果。 Firth、GEE 和变分贝叶斯方法在符号和量级上具有一致性（对于残差模型，每标准差对应的对数体积系数为 +4.8 至 +6.8）；但 REFLECT 数据集的拉普拉斯拟合未能收敛。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 gives the bias of every headline metric under every injected corruption for both verified pipelines, and Table 17 gives the power of the rank-stability and anti-location diagnostics. Rank stability detects every geometric corruption at n = 30 n=30 , including through-plane shifts that barely change the metrics, which is why we read it as a change detector. The anti-location rate detects the in-plane errors at n = 30 n=30 and otherwise reaches a power of 0.95 only at n = 312 n=312 , for two AnomalyDINO conditions (50% identifier permutation and doubled reference volume). A 5% permutation of subject identifiers is not detectable by either diagnostic at n ≤ 312 n\leq 312 , and a 20% permutation only by rank stability at n = 312 n=312 . Removing sub-floor reference fragments changed no metric, as expected, since no method ever hit one.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 给出了在每种注入的扰动下，所有已验证流程中每个主要指标的系统性偏差；表 17 则给出了秩稳定性诊断和反位置诊断的检出能力。 秩稳定性能够检测 n = 30 时所有的几何扰动（n=30），包括那些几乎不改变指标值的跨平面位移，因此我们将其视为一种变化检测器。 反位置率能够在 n = 30 时检测出平面内的错误（n=30）；而在其他情况下，只有当 n = 312 时（n=312），对于两种 AnomalyDINO 条件（50% 标识符置换和参考体积加倍），其检出能力才能达到 0.95。 在 n ≤ 312 时（n\leq 312），受试者标识符的 5% 置换无法被任一诊断方法检测到；而在 n = 312 时（n=312），只有秩稳定性能够检测出 20% 的置换。 移除低于基准线的参考片段并未改变任何指标，这与预期一致，因为没有任何方法曾检测到这类错误。

paragraphs.en: The single subject that failed the registration gate and the 42 subjects whose tumour extends beyond the 100-slice field of view of UCCD and cDDPM do not drive any result. Without subject 0044 (Table 18 ) five of 588 contrasts change interval-excludes-zero status, all by less than 0.0013 at the bound. In the 270 subjects with at least 95% of the tumour inside every field of view (Table 19 ) four estimates change sign and none changes status. A pre-specified through-plane offset check (Table 20 ) was positive only for AnomalyDINO, whose voxel AUROC peaks three slices away from the canonical position on both grids and in both subject subsets; its export was verified to be identical to the canonical data, and its numbers are reported without a shift.
paragraphs.zh: 未能通过注册关卡的单个受试者，以及肿瘤超出 UCCD 和 cDDPM 100 层视野范围的 42 名受试者，均未产生任何结果。 若排除受试者 0044（表 18），在 588 个对比中，有五个的“区间排除零”状态发生变化，且所有变化的边界值均小于 0.0013。 在至少 95% 的肿瘤位于每个视野内的 270 名受试者中（表 19），有四个估计值发生符号变化，但没有一个改变状态。 一项预先指定的通过平面偏移检查（表 20）仅在 AnomalyDINO 上呈阳性；其体素 AUROC 在两个网格和两个受试者子集中均于偏离标准位置三层的处达到峰值；经核实，其输出数据与标准数据完全一致，且相关数值未经偏移处理。

paragraphs.en: Ties matter for threshold-free metrics. Many brain voxels carry tied scores, a median of 65% per subject for UCCD and 26% for cDDPM (Table 22 ). Ordinal ranks, which break ties by array order, changed a subject’s voxel AUROC by up to 0.046 relative to mid-ranks; MIRTO uses mid-ranks and tie-collapsed average precision throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 对于无阈值指标而言，平局的处理至关重要。 许多脑区像素点具有相同的得分：在 UCCD 中，每个受试者的中位数为 65%；在 cDDPM 中为 26%（表 22）。 序数排名通过数组顺序打破平局，与中位数排名相比，可使某受试者的脑区像素点 AUROC 最多变化 0.046；MIRTO 全程使用中位数排名和去除了平局的平均精度。

paragraphs.en: Spatial randomisation controls (Table 23 ) apply known displacements to the stored maps: through-plane shifts by ± 2 \pm 2 , ± 5 \pm 5 and ± 10 \pm 10 slices, a permutation of slices within the subject, and the exchange of maps across subjects matched on brain area. Shifting a map by two slices costs at most 0.009 Dice, by ten slices 0.08 to 0.12 for the residual models; permuting slices within a subject or exchanging maps across subjects removes most of the Dice, leaving 0.06 to 0.07 when maps come from another subject. This confirms that Dice at the validation threshold depends on subject-specific localisation, as it should.
paragraphs.zh: 空间随机化控制（表23）对存储的地图应用已知的位移：沿平面的位移为±2±2、±5±5和±10±10个切片，同一受试者内切片的排列互换，以及在大脑区域上匹配的不同受试者间地图的交换。 将一张地图移动两个切片最多会损失0.009的Dice系数，移动十个切片则对残差模型造成0.08至0.12的损失；在同一受试者内排列互换切片或交换不同受试者的地图会消除大部分Dice系数，当地图来自另一受试者时，仅保留0.06至0.07。 这证实了验证阈值处的Dice系数确实依赖于受试者特定的定位信息，正如所预期的那样。

paragraphs.en: A 2 4 2^{4} geometry factorial (Table 24 ) switched four binary factors one at a time: the export transform (legacy or canonical), the reference (the method’s own reference or the canonical one), the evaluation support (the method’s own slices or the full canonical support) and the threshold (legacy or refitted on validation data). Apart from the threshold rule, every main effect on Dice was below 0.011 and every effect on voxel AUROC below 0.027 in absolute value; the threshold rule has no effect on AUROC by construction, which is a built-in check. The largest interactions were support × \times threshold ( + 0.042 +0.042 ) and grid × \times threshold ( + 0.022 +0.022 ), both for AnomalyDINO’s Dice.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 2 4 2^{4} 几何阶乘（表 24）依次切换了四个二进制因子：导出变换（旧版或标准版）、参考（该方法自身的参考或标准参考）、评估支持（该方法自身的切片或完整的标准支持）以及阈值（旧版或基于验证数据重新拟合的）。 除了阈值规则外，所有对 Dice 的主要影响绝对值均低于 0.011，所有对体素 AUROC 的影响绝对值均低于 0.027；根据设计，阈值规则对 AUROC 没有影响，这本身就是一个内置的检查机制。 最大的交互作用是支持 × \times 阈值（+0.042 +0.042）和网格 × \times 阈值（+0.022 +0.022），两者均针对 AnomalyDINO 的 Dice。

paragraphs.en: Tables 25 and 26 give every pairwise flip share and the full variance decomposition, for the defensible set and for all 155,520 universes. Including the non-defensible levels (the method’s own reference, the round-trip reference, the declared voxel volume, the fixed threshold and the per-subject optimal threshold) changes neither verdict: ϕ max = 0.450 ​ [ 0.398 , 0.498 ] \phi_{\max}=0.450\,[0.398,\,0.498] and the axis share is 0.595 against a method share of 0.169. REFLECT versus UCCD and REFLECT versus cDDPM have the same point flip share (7,337 of 15,552 universes each) by coincidence of counts. Within metrics (Table 27 ) voxel AUROC never changes order, whereas Dice and lesion sensitivity change it for every pair. Agreement with the reference universe was low: mean Kendall τ b \tau_{b} 0.486 [ 0.409 , 0.549 ] [0.409,0.549] , median 0.667, identical four-method order in 24.3% [ 9.9 , 32.4 ] [9.9,32.4] of universes. paragraphs.en: Table 33 gives every paired Dice contrast between the residual models, including 10 ​ cm 3 10\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} , and Table 34 every paired voxel-metric contrast, including those with AnomalyDINO. In voxel AUROC every residual model exceeds AnomalyDINO and REFLECT exceeds both diffusion models under every aggregation; UCCD and cDDPM differ by less than 0.011. In voxel AUPRC the order of the residual models depends on the aggregation: UCCD is below cDDPM in the subject mean and median ( p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005 ), and REFLECT is above UCCD only when voxels are pooled ( + 0.062 +0.062 , p H = 0.016 p_{\mathrm{H}}=0.016 ). Table 35 summarises how many contrasts of each declared family have Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 p<0.05 : at validation thresholds 20 to 22 of the 24 model-pair Dice contrasts do, at equal realised burden only 12 to 16. The slice-level score also depends on how a slice is summarised (Table 36 ): taking the slice mean instead of the maximum lowers marginal slice AUROC by 0.04 to 0.24 and puts AnomalyDINO below chance (0.425).
paragraphs.zh: 表33给出了残差模型之间所有成对的Dice对比（包括10 cm³ 10\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}），而表34则给出了所有成对的体素-指标对比，包括使用AnomalyDINO的对比。 在体素AUROC中，每个残差模型都优于AnomalyDINO，而REFLECT在所有聚合方式下均优于两种扩散模型；UCCD与cDDPM的差异小于0.011。 在体素AUPRC中，残差模型的排序取决于聚合方式：在受试者均值和中位数中，UCCD低于cDDPM（p H < 0.005 p_{\mathrm{H}}<0.005），而REFLECT仅在体素合并时高于UCCD（+0.062 +0.062，p H = 0.016 p_{\mathrm{H}}=0.016）。 表35总结了每个声明的对比族中有多少对比的Holm校正后p值小于0.05（p<0.05）：在验证阈值20至22时，24个模型对的Dice对比中有12至16个满足该条件；而在相等实现负担下，仅有12至16个满足。 切片级评分也取决于切片的总结方式（表36）：使用切片均值而非最大值会降低边际切片AUROC 0.04至0.24，并使AnomalyDINO的得分低于随机水平（0.425）。

paragraphs.en: The decomposition of Identity 5 at every budget (Table 37 ) shows the same pattern as at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} : the relaxation term is positive with an interval excluding zero for every method and budget, whereas the post-processing step at fixed threshold has an interval excluding zero on the positive side in only one case, UCCD at 40 ​ cm 3 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} ( + 0.022 +0.022 ). For AnomalyDINO the step at fixed threshold costs up to 0.075 Dice. Table 38 gives lesion sensitivity for plain thresholding, hysteresis, and hysteresis with pruning, at three hit criteria. Hysteresis alone lowers above-floor sensitivity by at most 0.015; most of the loss comes with the persistence pruning. The purity rule was evaluated on 52,399 (REFLECT), 43,873 (UCCD), 48,525 (cDDPM) and 92,296 (AnomalyDINO) predicted components.
paragraphs.zh: Identity 5 在每个预算下的分解（表 37）显示出与 20 cm³ 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时相同的模式：对于每种方法和每个预算，松弛项均为正值，且其区间不包含零；而固定阈值下的后处理步骤中，仅有一种情况（UCCD 在 40 cm³ 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} 时，+0.022 +0.022）的区间在正侧不包含零。 对于 AnomalyDINO，固定阈值步骤最多会损失 0.075 的 Dice 值。 表 38 给出了在三种命中标准下，普通阈值化、滞后处理以及带修剪的滞后处理的病变敏感度。 仅使用滞后处理会使高于基线的敏感度最多降低 0.015；大部分损失来自持续性修剪。 纯度规则在 52,399（REFLECT）、43,873（UCCD）、48,525（cDDPM）和 92,296（AnomalyDINO）个预测组件上进行了评估。

Tables 43 and 44 give the overlap of missed-lesion sets and the error modes behind Fig. 11 a; AnomalyDINO differs from the residual models in that most of its misses are selected but poorly delineated (189 of 373). The label-informed upper bounds at every budget are in Table 45 . A per-subject threshold with no burden cap (Table 46 ) bounds what any choice of a single threshold per subject could achieve: 0.580 to 0.605 Dice for the residual models and 0.373 for AnomalyDINO, the latter at a mean false-positive volume of 156 ​ cm 3 156\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . Table 47 gives every detection model.

paragraphs.en: Tables 48 , 49 and 50 give the baseline contrasts at every budget and aggregation and the share of universes in which a baseline outranks a model. paragraphs.en: Table 51 lists every score rule against the published map in both checkpoints, Table 52 each rule at its own validation threshold, and Table 53 the retention criterion for MAD. Every latent aggregation improves on the published map in both checkpoints and under both matchings; latent-only scoring is worse in every setting; the image stream alone is better than the published fusion in all four settings at 20 ​ cm 3 20\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} . The image-only rule is infeasible at 5 ​ cm 3 5\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} on the validation set, and removing the clip has inconsistent effects.

paragraphs.en: Table 56 summarises the comparison with a common training set. Within IXI-HH+Guys the methods kept their own training protocols: REFLECT trained on all 504 IXI T2 volumes of the pool (stage 1, 200 epochs; re-flow, 50 epochs); UCCD on 324 training and 81 validation volumes (encoder and diffusion model taken at their best validation loss); cDDPM on 361 training and 92 validation volumes (best validation loss at epoch 1,426 of 1,600, 2,854 optimisation steps); AnomalyDINO built its memory bank from 50 reference volumes with slice stride 2. The optimisation budget of a single method varies strongly between training sets (cDDPM: 2,854 steps on IXI-HH+Guys, 79,040 on MOOD+IXI), so effects of the training set are effects of the training data together with the protocol that came with it. One model was trained per method and training set, so variance between training runs is not estimated; it is the most plausible competing explanation for the smaller differences between methods. The ranking-instability and evaluation-dominance hypotheses were supported with every common training set ( ϕ max \phi_{\max} from 0.295 to 0.485).
paragraphs.zh: 表 56 总结了与一个常用训练集的对比。 在 IXI-HH+Guys 数据集中，各方法保留了各自的训练协议：REFLECT 在池中全部 504 个 IXI T2 体积上进行训练（阶段 1，200 个周期；再流，50 个周期）；UCCD 在 324 个训练体积和 81 个验证体积上进行训练（编码器和扩散模型均取其最佳验证损失值）；cDDPM 在 361 个训练体积和 92 个验证体积上进行训练（在 1,600 个周期中的第 1,426 个周期达到最佳验证损失，共 2,854 步优化）；AnomalyDINO 从 50 个参考体积中构建其记忆库，切片步长为 2。 单一方法在不同训练集上的优化预算差异显著（cDDPM：在 IXI-HH+Guys 上为 2,854 步，在 MOOD+IXI 上为 79,040 步），因此训练集的影响实际上是训练数据及其附带协议共同作用的结果。 每种方法和每个训练集仅训练了一个模型，因此未估计不同训练运行之间的方差；这是解释各方法间差异较小的最合理解释。 在所有常用训练集中，排名不稳定性和评估主导性假设均得到了支持（ϕ max \phi_{\max} 的取值范围从 0.295 到 0.485）。

With the training set as an eleventh axis (Table 58 ) the method × \times training-set interaction carries 0.115 of Dice variance and 0.142 of voxel AUPRC variance, against 0.028 and 0.056 for the main effect of the training set, so the training data mainly change which method benefits. Table 61 gives the stability of each selection rule. Selecting per method with the threshold refitted inside leave-one-subject-out folds of the validation set chooses REFLECT on MOOD+IXI, UCCD and cDDPM on IXI-Guys and AnomalyDINO on IXI-HH+Guys, and reproduces the test-selected order (UCCD 0.576 > > REFLECT 0.552 > > cDDPM 0.507 > > AnomalyDINO 0.166); that joint choice, however, occurs in only 22.0% of validation resamples, and its four-method order differs from the IXI-HH+Guys order in 81.4% of defensible universes. Deviations from the stated analyses are listed after the table.

sents.en: Table 63 gives the eight secondary hypotheses, each a prediction about a specific effect that follows from the identities of Section 2 or from the primary analyses, tested with all methods trained on IXI-HH+Guys.

sents.en: Deviations from the stated analyses are listed after the table.
sents.zh: 与所列分析的任何偏离均列于表格之后。

paragraphs.en: (1) The stated description of the training data names all three IXI sites; our IXI T2 data contain no subjects from the third site (IOP), so IXI-HH+Guys comprises the Hammersmith and Guy’s sites, identically for all methods. (2) The canonical arrays are a through-plane-cropped copy (98–149 slices) of the 240 × 240 × 155 240\times 240\times 155 originals; no tumour voxel is affected. (3) The contrast-dependence hypothesis could be tested only in part, because the available labels are binary. (4) The pruning trade-off was judged from point estimates, as no interval was computed for it. (5) The stratified and matched slice-level estimators named in H9 fail their covariate-only check; the regression estimator, added as an exploratory alternative, fails as well. (6) The family of six latent-aggregation rules specified for this experiment could not be computed from the stored latents; the family reported here is exploratory. (7) A pre-specified through-plane offset check was positive for AnomalyDINO, whose voxel AUROC peaks three slices from the canonical position ( + 0.008 +0.008 ); its export was verified to be identical to the canonical data and its numbers are reported without a shift, a decision made with knowledge of the check’s result. (8) One subject fails the overlap floor of the registration gate for UCCD and cDDPM and is kept; excluding it is immaterial (Section 3.1 ). (9) No untouched BraTS 2020 subjects remain for a hold-out set, so confirmation requires a new cohort, to be evaluated under a pre-registered protocol that fixes the training set and every threshold rule.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 训练数据的描述中明确提到了所有三个 IXI 站点；我们的 IXI T2 数据不包含来自第三个站点（IOP）的任何受试者，因此 IXI-HH+Guys 包含了 Hammersmith 和 Guy’s 站点，所有方法均以此为基础。 (2) 标准数组是原始 240 × 240 × 155 数据沿平面方向裁剪后的副本（98–149 个切片），没有任何肿瘤体素受到影响。 (3) 对比度依赖假设仅能部分验证，因为可用的标签是二元的。 (4) 剪枝权衡的判断基于点估计，因为未为其计算置信区间。 (5) H9 中提到的分层和匹配切片级估计器未能通过协变量单独检验；作为探索性替代方案添加的回归估计器同样未能通过检验。 (6) 本实验指定的六个潜在聚合规则族无法从存储的潜在数据中计算得出；此处报告的规则族属于探索性质。 (7) 对于 AnomalyDINO，预先指定的沿平面偏移检查呈阳性，其体素 AUROC 在标准位置偏移三个切片处达到峰值（+0.008）；经验证，其输出数据与标准数据完全一致，且报告的数据未经偏移调整——这一决定是在了解检查结果后作出的。 (8) 一名受试者未通过 UCCD 和 cDDPM 配准门限的重叠下限要求，但仍被保留；将其排除不会影响结果（第 3.1 节）。 (9) 已无未经处理的 BraTS 2020 受试者可用于预留集，因此验证需要一个新的队列，该队列将根据预先注册的协议进行评估，而该协议固定了训练集和所有阈值规则。

paragraphs.en: Analyses used Python 3.11 with NumPy, pandas, SciPy and statsmodels, and R with lme4 for the mixed models and logistf for Firth regression. The evaluator implements every gate, diagnostic, metric and identity of Section 2 and is checked against 31 synthetic test cases, each with a known answer. Computational cost is reported in Appendix 0.D.10 .
paragraphs.zh: 分析使用了 Python 3.11 以及 NumPy、pandas、SciPy 和 statsmodels，并使用了 R 中的 lme4 进行混合模型分析，以及 logistf 进行 Firth 回归分析。 评估器实现了第 2 节中的所有门、诊断方法、指标和身份验证机制，并通过 31 个合成测试用例进行了验证，每个测试用例都有已知答案。 计算成本在附录 0.D.10 中报告。
